Friends, the California Democratic Party joins the nation today in mourning the passing of Senator Dianne Feinstein.

As the first female president of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, Feinstein drew national attention for her heroism and leadership as she guided the city through the aftermath of the 1978 assassinations of Mayor George Moscone and Supervisor Harvey Milk.

**Over the next 44 years, that same leadership and drive to serve the people made Dianne Feinstein a leading light for Democrats across America.**

_Dianne Feinstein speaking as San Francisco mayor in 1986._
As San Fransisco Mayor, and then as US Senator, Dianne Feinstein played a central role in writing the history of California and the nation – expanding civil rights, preserving precious land, advocating for marriage equality, banning assault weapons, and much more.

**The longest-serving female US Senator in our nation’s history, Dianne Feinstein will be remembered for her honorable legacy as a trailblazing Californian whose work changed the lives and futures of countless Americans.**

Our thoughts are with the Senator’s family and friends in this difficult moment.

Over the next 44 years, that same leadership and drive to serve the people made Dianne Feinstein a leading light for Democrats across America. Dianne Feinstein speaking as San Francisco mayor in 1986. As San Fransisco Mayor, and then as US Senator, Dianne Feinstein played a central role in writing the history of California and the nation – expanding civil rights, preserving precious land, advocating for marriage equality, banning assault weapons, and much more. The longest-serving female US Senator in our nation’s history, Dianne Feinstein will be remembered for her honorable legacy as a trailblazing Californian whose work changed the lives and futures of countless Americans. Our thoughts are with the Senator’s family and friends in this difficult moment. California Democratic Party (CADEM) | Our Democratic leaders are working hard to make California a better place to live. From fighting for good-paying jobs, combating climate change, to expanding healthcare access so all Californians can lead safe, healthy, prosperous lives — California’s Democratic leaders turn progressive ideas into meaningful action. Hello,
When I decided to run against Lauren Boebert in 2022, people warned me what would happen. Politics is a “blood sport,” they said. The attacks would get nasty. I tried to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what would come. But I never could have imagined the things that Boebert and her far-right allies would make up and put on TV.
**Now, after we came just 546 votes short of kicking Lauren Boebert out of Congress (the closest race in the entire country!), the attacks have gotten even nastier – including Fox News and Boebert attacking my 81-year-old father for being a retired OB-GYN.**
Lauren Boebert and her Super PACs are going to spend millions running the most ridiculous ads they can attacking me. We have to be ready if we’re going to win.
I’m facing a critical federally-mandated FEC fundraising deadline at midnight tomorrow, and if the Super PACs sense even one shred of weakness in our public fundraising report, they’ll pounce with more attacks to try to bury us.
**We’re just $68,301 away from our goal and what we need to counter the lies and hold Lauren Boebert accountable. But I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to hit this goal and have the resources I need to win:**

subject: Biden Corruption Gets WORSE!
body:
Biden Secret Service Records Show Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Was Denied
Protection Despite Numerous Threats

[WEEKLY UPDATE]

BIDEN CORRUPTION GETS WORSE!

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30319&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdmlkZW9zL2JpZGVuLWNvcnJ1cHRpb24tZ2V0cy13b3JzZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=c83092ff6b7d20a90638ac58c483cde3cbe672161632093c847d3b1a05ca6df5]

BIDEN SECRET SERVICE RECORDS SHOW ROBERT F. KENNEDY JR. WAS DENIED
PROTECTION DESPITE NUMEROUS THREATS

The Biden administration doesn’t look good on this one – to put
it mildly.

We received 11-pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30320&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3NlY3JldC1zZXJ2aWNlLWtlbm5lZHktcHJvdGVjdGlvbi1zZXB0ZW1iZXItMjAyMy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=f7e3ec3e10633693c7b59beb93b2cbc1c7c4d68e9e029fe1b3a9de12d467526f]
of
Secret Service records detailing the denial of protection to
presidential candidate Robert F. Kennedy Jr., despite his having
received numerous threats from “known subjects.”

We received the document from the in response to a July 28, 2023,
Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request for records and
communications of:

> a) Director Kimberly A. Cheatle
>
> b) Deputy Director Ronald L. Rowe, Jr.
>
> c) Chief Operating Officer Cynthia Sjoberg Radway
>
> d) Assistant Director, Office of Protective Operations, Michael
> Plati

On July 28, 2023, Kennedy posted
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30321&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9Sb2JlcnRLZW5uZWR5SnIvc3RhdHVzLzE2ODQ5MDkzODUzNzY1NzU0ODg/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=73387314999207c8a9594f69a58c0f36e2d323c9817b392af386b052296e4f3e]
to X
(formerly Twitter), “Since the assassination of my father in 1968,
candidates for president are provided Secret Service protection. But
not me.”

Just last week, Kennedy again requested
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30322&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9hYmNuZXdzLmdvLmNvbS9Qb2xpdGljcy9yZmstanItcmVuZXdzLWNhbGxzLXNlY3JldC1zZXJ2aWNlLXByb3RlY3Rpb24tYWZ0ZXIvc3Rvcnk/aWQ9MTAzMjg2NTg1JnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=9d8b37077da3c38c00ef49679b5aff2f48e4a7aa169eb9287d00f4aa05fd8aeb]
Secret
Service protection following an incident on the campaign trail
involving an armed man impersonating a police officer.

The records we obtained include a Secret Service “Protective
Intelligence and Assessment” that reveals numerous threats to
Kennedy (“Behaviors of Interest”):

> On April 23, 2023, a known subject [Redacted] submitted an
> inappropriate comment on the White House website addressed to
> President Biden [Redacted] stated, “Born to a political family,
> his twelfth cousin—Robert Kennedy—announces their candidacy to
> succeed Joseph Biden for ‘President of the United States.’
> There’s no way you'd... assassinate former president Donald Trump.
> `Go get 'ern, kiddo!” No further USSS investigation was
> conducted.
>
> [Redacted]
>
> A known subject [Redacted] mailed a nonsensical letter to the hotel
> where Kennedy held his presidential campaign announcement event
> [redacted] warned a “madman” may commit a “serious terrorist
> act” and wanted to discuss his sins with Kennedy. [Redacted] is of
> record with the USSS [Secret Service] since March 2023 after he sent
> a nonsensical letter to President Biden with similar rhetoric. The
> USSS investigation is complete.
>
> A known subject [Redacted] sent numerous packages, including gifts
> and a wedding band, to Kennedy [Redacted] stated that she loves
> Kennedy and expressed anger about being kept away from him.
> [Redacted]
>
> A known subject [Redacted] sent materials to Kennedy’s residence.
> One letter contained a 32-page manifesto in which [Redacted] made
> nonsensical religious references and described himself as a
> “commissioned messenger of God.”
>
> A known subject [Redacted] regularly sends threatening emails,
> stating he will “bury” Kennedy, “everyone will die,” and
> that he will make Kennedy “suffer.”
>
> A subject [Redacted] sent inappropriate communications to Kennedy.
> The subject believed Kennedy was spying on him, paying people to
> follow him, and was responsible for vandalism against him. The
> subject state “your behavior has complete [sic] freaked me out.
> Focus on your damn campaign and leave me the hell alone.”

The assessment also notes:

> Many comments suggested that, for no other reason than that he is a
> Kennedy, he would be at risk of assassination. In May 2023, Kennedy
> received increased media attention after accusing the CIA of
> involvement in the assassination of his uncle. Kennedy has advocated
> for the release of the individual currently imprisoned for
> assassinating his father, Sirhan Sirhan, because he believes a CIA
> contractor was responsible for the death.
>
> Kennedy has received both support and criticism for his stance on
> vaccines and has been described as an anti-vaccine activist.

In a July 28, 2023, email chain with the subject line “RFK Jr Says
Biden Administration Denied Him Secret Service Protection - The
Messenger” Secret Service officials discuss a news article in which
Kennedy makes a case for protection.

The chief of communications, whose name is redacted, writes to Michael
Plati, the assistant director of Protective Operations, and others:
“We’re getting Press calls on this and sending to DHS.”

An official in the Office of Intergovernmental and Legislative
Affairs, whose name is redacted, responds: “Request for protection
to DHS dated 5/26; Response by Congressional Advisory Board 7 /11;
Passed to DHS front office on 7 /14.”

The deputy special agent in charge, whose name is redacted, adds:

> [T]he following language was key to the recommendation and
> subsequent decision.
>
> “Protection under these guidelines should only be granted within
> one year prior to the general election. Protection more than one
> year prior to the general election should only be granted in
> extraordinary, case by case circumstances in consultation with the
> committee, based on threat assessment and other factors.”

The records were produced earlier this week, the day after we filed
aFOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30323&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZGhzLXJvYmVydC1rZW5uZWR5LWNvbXBsYWludC0wMjg0Ni8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=c9ea8a9fa8d865feceb0728a2a0eb5ad90eec00f51b0713d8b443abed4d03fa9]
against
the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) over similar but
broader requests for DHS/Secret Service leadership records regarding
the decision to not provide Secret Service protection for Kennedy
(_Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30324&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZGhzLXJvYmVydC1rZW5uZWR5LWNvbXBsYWludC0wMjg0Ni9dXz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=c3ff812ff9fed0573b16b560a8d334a051a09afe763a7e782e76fa16c9976293
(No.
1:23-cv-02846)).

The Biden administration’s refusal to provide Secret Service
protection to Mr. Kennedy is dangerous and vindictive. These FOIA
requests and our new lawsuit aim to get the full truth on why Mr.
Kennedy’s life is being put at unnecessary risk by the Biden
administration.

We’ll be sure to keep you apprised if we uncover any other documents
on this disturbing issue.

BIDEN AGENCY SPENDS $100 MILLION TO HELP DISADVANTAGED COMMUNITIES
BY FIXING BROKEN ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGERS

What happens when two of the ideology-driven
Biden administration’s policies come in contact? You get an
outrageous waste of your tax dollars, as our _Corruption
Chronicles_ blog reports
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30318&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvYnJva2VuLWV2LWNoYXJnZXJzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=91bcb7ddae621b4c031c497de2604f9cfe5204f8ace3678c1222bde33ccf4de4].

> Besides subsidizing the electric vehicle (EV) industry with a
> staggering $15.5 billion
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30325&F=T&&hash=6a242328c43f9bd5f404b555dc43a6670f536eaafa6e798ba67fdf83c27e11dc],
the
> Biden administration is investing an additional $100 million
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30326&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ3JhbnRzLmdvdi93ZWIvZ3JhbnRzL3ZpZXctb3Bwb3J0dW5pdHkuaHRtbD9vcHBJZD0zNTAxOTAmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=154a404ca0962b2efa79394bf351e02a7e36959233d4156a78e464bfe9eb7b63]
in
> federal funding to prioritize the repair and replacement of EV
> charging stations throughout the U.S. The venture will “ensure
> disadvantaged communities benefit from upgraded charging
> infrastructure,” according to the Department of Transportation
> (DOT), which is doling out the money. The costly EV charger project
> is part of the administration’s Justice40 Initiative
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30327&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2hpdGVob3VzZS5nb3YvZW52aXJvbm1lbnRhbGp1c3RpY2UvanVzdGljZTQwLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=ea74eb34769fde607c687f8eba888a174379d46b68bbc68e1acc7617ba2fbaa6]
which
> requires 40% of all federal government investments to flow to
> “disadvantaged communities that are marginalized, underserved, and
> overburdened with pollution.” The president signed an executive
> order within days of taking office to allocate unprecedented public
> funds to poor minority communities in the name of environmental
> justice.
>
> The multi-million-dollar EV charger restoration project will operate
> under a Justice40 initiative known as National Electric Vehicle
> Infrastructure (NEVI) Formula Program that provides states with
> money to strategically deploy charging stations and establish an
> interconnected network to facilitate data collection, access and
> reliability. “The Biden-Harris Administration has set a goal of
> building a convenient, affordable, reliable, equitable, and
> Made-in-America electric vehicle (EV) charging network along the
> Nation’s highways and within our communities,” according to the
> grant announcement issued this month by the DOT. Because it is a
> Justice40 program the feds will use a White House Climate and
> Economic Justice Screening Tool
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30328&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9zY3JlZW5pbmd0b29sLmdlb3BsYXRmb3JtLmdvdi9lbi9hYm91dD91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=9392b0cfff1072ef159dd255409fe140765aa5df65d46d299e09083db2cb7587]
to track how
> assisted chargers aid needy communities. “Recipients of awards
> under this program can also use the tool to ensure
> disadvantaged communities benefit from upgraded charging
> infrastructure,” the grant document states, adding that “the
> tool can be used to help prioritize and sequence projects to
> maximize benefits to disadvantaged communities.”
>
> The White House launched the Climate and Economic Justice Screening
> Tool in response to the president’s January 2021 order
>
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65231&L=30329&F=T&&hash=447a7c25ada5e6c9c69df4d33fb64fc4af09a2e5801da7f343ad93090acae608
> tackle the “climate crisis at home and abroad.” The directive
> includes an extensive section dedicated to securing environmental
> justice for disadvantaged, historically marginalized and
> overburdened communities, by among other things, creating a White
> House Environmental Justice Interagency Council consisting of top
> government leaders.
>
> The heads of key federal agencies—including the attorney general,
> secretaries of defense, labor, transportation and energy—were

**Meet Bernie Moreno:** | Bernie Moreno fights for the American dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Gabe won the most competitive Democratic seat in Congress in 2022, and is running to be a champion for working families and build an economy that benefits everyone. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Hey, did you see Gabe’s message earlier? We need to make sure you understand just how high the stakes are right now. Right now, our government is facing the threat of a Republican Government Shutdown. The frustrating truth is this could easily be avoided. But my opponent’s far-right Republicans are holding the government hostage rather than working across the aisle to fund critical resources — and Kevin McCarthy is sitting back, doing nothing, and allowing this to happen. Politico just reported that “[Kevin] McCarthy hasn’t phoned a single member of the opposing party about a way to keep the lights on.” I’ll be blunt: there are some Republican colleagues who I enjoy working with, and who represent their districts with integrity. But I’ve had a front-row seat to this chaos as a Congressman, and it’s hurting my constituents. It’s time for Democrats to take back the House majority, and the only way to do that is to consistently hit our fundraising goals between now and Election Day in 2024. But right now, we have less than two days before the first public-facing FEC deadline since I officially launched my reelection campaign, and we’re not nearly where we need to be to reach our $25,000 end-of-quarter goal in time. = | = Thank you. No matter what, I want you to know that I remain committed to working for the people of New Mexico, no matter what party holds power. — Gabe | KEEP GABE IN CONGRESS Together, we flipped NM-02 in 2022. Now, Gabe is busy in Congress fighting for reproductive choice, economic opportunity, affordable healthcare, and the best interests of the people. Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

name: Staff Sgt. Aquilino Gonell
subject: They attacked us with the American flag.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
The same flag I swore an oath to when I joined the Army.
#

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept23.a-3sdr&refcode=em230929-1-NOR&t=1&akid=1300%2E734936%2E0VPlGJ)
---
Peter -
I will never forget January 6th. I was more afraid at the Capitol that day than I was in my entire deployment to Iraq.
On January 6th, I was assaulted by more than 40 rioters and mob members who were part of concerted efforts to overtake the Capitol. I was sprayed with bear mace, punched, kicked, beaten with stolen police batons and weapons. They even attacked us with the American flag.
I still bear the scars of this day and am saddened every time I think about my career being cut short because of this day.
I honestly thought I was going to die.
But I fought back. I fought for our democracy.
I'm still fighting for it.
And while I was fighting the mob, Ruben Gallego was on the House floor. He helped barricade the doors. He taught his colleagues how to use a gas mask. He was ready to fight for our democracy again, same as when he joined the Marines, same as when he fought in Iraq.
He's still fighting for it, too.
He's fighting to beat the people who led those insurrectionists, who cheer them on, who defend them — peoplein Arizona like Mark Lamb, like Kari Lake, like Blake Masters.
Ruben is the kind of leader we need in the Senate, not them. I’m proud to support him. And that's why I'm writing to you today.
To win, he is going to need your help.
[**Can he count on you? Make today the day that you give your first donation to Ruben’s Arizona Senate campaign.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept23.a-3sdr&refcode=em230929-1-NOR&t=2&akid=1300%2E734936%2E0VPlGJ)

name: Christine Drazan
subject: Measure 110 has proven to be a full-scale failure
body:
Urge Kotek and her task force to prioritize the repeal of measure 110
[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-r/)
### Friend,
Recently, Governor Kotek assembled a task force to address the issues that continue to stymie the city of Portland--of which there are many. **Missing from the discussion: addiction** and the impact the decriminalization of hard drugs has had on all the others issues that plague our state's biggest city.
### [_**We are launching a petition to urge Governor Kotek and the task force to prioritize responding to overwhelming data on overdose deaths and addiction rates by repealing Measure 110.**_ ](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-y/)This measure decriminalized the possession of hard drugs, and it has left scars not just in Portland, but the entire state.
[SIGN THE PETITION HERE](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-j/) **Measure 110 has proven to be a full-scale failure, leading to record addiction rates and a surge in tragic overdoses.[_It's time to address this issue and work toward a solution that focuses on prevention and truly helps Oregonians get clean and stay clean._](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-t/)**[_**By signing this petition**_](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-i/) , you are making sure Kotek and the task force don't ignore the real problem. **The challenges facing Portland are significant but for the City of Roses to bloom again we must repeal Measure 110.** Thank you, Christine Drazan [](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-d/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-h/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-o/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-b/) | [Preferences](https://andor.updatemyprofile.com/y-puudtc-172B6299-dihkkhuuli-n) | [Unsubscribe](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-u-puudtc-dihkkhuuli-p/)

name: Captain Sam Brown
subject: Friend [INTERNAL REQUEST]
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sam Brown for Nevada
body:
My name is Sam Brown, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

| | |
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23414%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2GiOwyYt53fQY5t4zxa%2bMw&sysid=1)
---
Friend, I’ve written this letter to you and I really hope that you take a couple minutes to read it, but if you’re strapped for time, here are the highlights. My name is Sam Brown, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I was seriously injured while serving in Afghanistan, but in retrospect those injuries changed my life for the better and gave me the perspective I needed to become the man I am today. Today, I’m a husband, father, small businessman, and I’m the frontrunner for the Republican Senate nomination. Nevada will be the lynchpin state for both the U.S. Senate and the Presidential election in 2024. The most important fundraising deadline of the 2024 cycle is coming up. **[Would you consider rushing in $$ before our deadline?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23425%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QvJdPpnJ3pJ6cnkdpnS3yQ&sysid=1)** _Now, here’s my story, Friend._
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23414%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2GiOwyYt53fQY5t4zxa%2bMw&sysid=1)
---
This is a picture of me and my father. I don’t remember a time when service to my family, my community, and my country wasn’t central to my plans for the future. My dad was the one who raised me to give my life to God and country. In highschool, I knew that joining the military was a key part of my career path. But after the 9/11 attacks, my desire to serve my country transformed from just a career path into an ironclad resolve and passion. A few years later, I graduated from West Point and was commissioned as an infantry officer. I answered the call from my country to fight in Afghanistan.
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23414%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2GiOwyYt53fQY5t4zxa%2bMw&sysid=1)
---
Four months into my deployment, my life changed in ways that I couldn’t have imagined. My team and I were on our way to provide support to an embattled platoon. On our way to the engagement zone, my team and ran over a roadside bomb. It all happened in an instant. The explosion soaked me in diesel and flames ignited all over my body. My gunner was able to put out the flames and save my life. If I’d been on fire for another minute I wouldn’t be writing this message to you today.
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23414%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2GiOwyYt53fQY5t4zxa%2bMw&sysid=1)
---
I was rushed back to a hospital in Texas where I’d undergo countless surgeries and 3 years of rehabilitation. I’m not telling you my story because I want you to pity me or see me as a hero. Certainly, I’m not the first or last person to be injured in the line of duty. **[I want you to know my story because I hope that it’ll give you confidence that I’m not a regular politician who will arrive in Washington D.C. and on day one and forget about the people I serve or those who’ve fought to defend our country.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23426%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EXdOS8cVC6Gac49c%2bpAmDA&sysid=1)** Friend, God’s plans for my life were far better than anything I could’ve come up with... And, in retrospect, my injuries weren’t the end of my life... Rather, they were the beginning of a new one. While recovering from my injuries, I met my wife Amy, and since then we’ve had 3 incredible children. While working a warehouse job, I built a business that gave me the opportunity to continue to serve Americans by sprinting around the red tape and providing emergency pharmaceutical care to veterans outside of the Veterans Health Administration. _**[Friend, if you help send me to the U.S. Senate, this is the exact attitude I will bring with me.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23427%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YujxKtZizIWHwOpT6DP1sQ&sysid=1)**_ I will NEVER take your support for granted - and I won’t ever stop fighting to protect our country from the radical left.
---
[**Help Send CPT Brown to the Senate!**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23428%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cX32r5CILF%2bRtVO1IAgWvw&sysid=1)
---
I wish I could take on the Democrat establishment on my own, and I wish I could beat their $100 million war chest by myself. **[But the simple fact is that I can’t do this without YOUR support, Friend. And with a HUGE end of quarter fundraising deadline just around the corner, I need your help more than ever.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23429%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jMlNoBmlv%2bZwmFGhLC0KsA&sysid=1)** Duty First,
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23414%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2GiOwyYt53fQY5t4zxa%2bMw&sysid=1)
---
CPT Sam Brown, U.S. Army, Ret. P.S. Nevada is the nation’s most hotly contested battleground state and will likely decide the balance of power in the Senate AND who wins the Presidential election. That means I’m target number one for Joe Biden, the DNC, and the radical left’s billionaire best friends. The ONLY I know of to fight back is by enlisting the support of conservative patriots like YOU, Friend. **[Would you please consider rushing in an urgently needed End of Quarter donation?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23420%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AquSBTi9h%2bs3m0eroCODag&sysid=1)**
---

---

subject: I have a story I’d like you to hear

body:
I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zc9oonmajfkesnglvn3rqr6anrbjq72qpf2auugo_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1o32c3h2bs)
---

Friend, I took the stage at the second Republican presidential primary debate on September 27th to fight tooth and nail for our country, our freedom, our future, and your children because I know one thing to be true: _America is**suffering** , and it's up to US to change course._ **I have good news:** we're one step closer to defeating Joe Biden and dismantling the woke indoctrination that's run rampant across this country after we dominated on the debate stage. No excuses. Once again, we got the job done. Now, it's time to kick up the intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who I am and who I'm fighting for so you can join me in this critical race.
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7l9lb8acnb0bputondvv4k06l3modnlm1kk7h1o_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1o32c3h2bs)
---
I'm a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmhmmk2rpjc4hmgca88aobqro3pnstgdg1scpoeg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1o32c3h2bs)
---
After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I've watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zl00l9i9rjp42nm0ev1i7r3puev6kvhi8hddfea0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1o32c3h2bs)
---
I have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

---
As Governor of Florida, I've made it my mission to lead with conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought they deserved the power to control American lives, and we benefitted because of it. **Leadership matters.** We've set the example in Florida. But if we don't get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they've caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. But we can't win unless we come together and defeat Joe Biden next November. I want you to know, Friend: I am not running to be President, I am running to get things done as President. **Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024:_Freedom or Decline._**_ _ I made my case for the choice I need you to make with me on that debate stage in California. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I will continue to show up and take this vision of our Great American Comeback directly to you, as a Presidential candidate should.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Friend, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we've held more than 120 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

But, we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter deadline is here in just 2 days.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkn3sfofio3ele352abjj4m8bfl299ucu9d5pt38_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1o32c3h2bs "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter is here in just 2 days.")**_

---

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before September 30 at 11:59 PM?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrghqog99nn8sdctrsr79uvmp7kp2u3qivpsgft8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1o32c3h2bs "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before September 30 at 11:59 PM?")**

_I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for._

As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me.

As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it.

As Governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as Ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

Our moment is now - and our mission is clear.

_**[Will you help me save our country and secure our future?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf3qddacoackteuik41spelsj6duupkijhj5f5l0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1o32c3h2bs "Will you help me save our country and secure our future?")**_

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

body:
I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zu8onl3vru6vk75529gcnqpbj770c3su8g9b08bg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1p70cjh2bs)
---

Friend, I took the stage at the second Republican presidential primary debate on September 27th to fight tooth and nail for our country, our freedom, our future, and your children because I know one thing to be true: _America is**suffering** , and it's up to US to change course._ **I have good news:** we're one step closer to defeating Joe Biden and dismantling the woke indoctrination that's run rampant across this country after we dominated on the debate stage. No excuses. Once again, we got the job done. Now, it's time to kick up the intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who I am and who I'm fighting for so you can join me in this critical race.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhoj8eie7qtf8b2nt8i3dp94r2uk99g8d1qk7g6o_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1p70cjh2bs)
---
I'm a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zkevshc330sr7ik6c2lb2aatkiot9js6k8e6b4og_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1p70cjh2bs)
---
After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I've watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zppnrvqdb8ttc12ue7gu47uvcio6oc4c07lbvod8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1p70cjh2bs)
---
I have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.
---

| | [This is my vision for America. Help make it a reality > CHIP IN $10](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z6t7lqiss9at81qg2nqbhtuh8s7rterdn5o8lvig_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1hm1p70cjh2bs)
---
As Governor of Florida, I've made it my mission to lead with conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought they deserved the power to control American lives, and we benefitted because of it. **Leadership matters.** We've set the example in Florida. But if we don't get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they've caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. But we can't win unless we come together and defeat Joe Biden next November. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I will continue to show up and take this vision of our Great American Comeback directly to you, as a Presidential candidate should.

body:
My name is Sam Brown, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

| | |
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678392%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5OWj5RAuIo1sAwurNg4Umg&sysid=1)
---
Friend, I’ve written this letter to you and I really hope that you take a couple minutes to read it, but if you’re strapped for time, here are the highlights. My name is Sam Brown, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I was seriously injured while serving in Afghanistan, but in retrospect those injuries changed my life for the better and gave me the perspective I needed to become the man I am today. Today, I’m a husband, father, small businessman, and I’m the frontrunner for the Republican Senate nomination. Nevada will be the lynchpin state for both the U.S. Senate and the Presidential election in 2024. The most important fundraising deadline of the 2024 cycle is coming up. **[Would you consider rushing in $$ before our deadline?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678393%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Pr9j7bpTcFVG%2bB3QC%2fin1w&sysid=1)** _Now, here’s my story, Friend._
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678392%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5OWj5RAuIo1sAwurNg4Umg&sysid=1)
---
This is a picture of me and my father. I don’t remember a time when service to my family, my community, and my country wasn’t central to my plans for the future. My dad was the one who raised me to give my life to God and country. In highschool, I knew that joining the military was a key part of my career path. But after the 9/11 attacks, my desire to serve my country transformed from just a career path into an ironclad resolve and passion. A few years later, I graduated from West Point and was commissioned as an infantry officer. I answered the call from my country to fight in Afghanistan.
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678392%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5OWj5RAuIo1sAwurNg4Umg&sysid=1)
---
Four months into my deployment, my life changed in ways that I couldn’t have imagined. My team and I were on our way to provide support to an embattled platoon. On our way to the engagement zone, my team and ran over a roadside bomb. It all happened in an instant. The explosion soaked me in diesel and flames ignited all over my body. My gunner was able to put out the flames and save my life. If I’d been on fire for another minute I wouldn’t be writing this message to you today.
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678392%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5OWj5RAuIo1sAwurNg4Umg&sysid=1)
---
I was rushed back to a hospital in Texas where I’d undergo countless surgeries and 3 years of rehabilitation. I’m not telling you my story because I want you to pity me or see me as a hero. Certainly, I’m not the first or last person to be injured in the line of duty. **[I want you to know my story because I hope that it’ll give you confidence that I’m not a regular politician who will arrive in Washington D.C. and on day one and forget about the people I serve or those who’ve fought to defend our country.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678394%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CBpkvuZ11DddZfs3laQjTQ&sysid=1)** Friend, God’s plans for my life were far better than anything I could’ve come up with... And, in retrospect, my injuries weren’t the end of my life... Rather, they were the beginning of a new one. While recovering from my injuries, I met my wife Amy, and since then we’ve had 3 incredible children. While working a warehouse job, I built a business that gave me the opportunity to continue to serve Americans by sprinting around the red tape and providing emergency pharmaceutical care to veterans outside of the Veterans Health Administration. _**[Friend, if you help send me to the U.S. Senate, this is the exact attitude I will bring with me.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678305%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JnMNdhQMrjteUcmXAtvNLw&sysid=1)**_ I will NEVER take your support for granted - and I won’t ever stop fighting to protect our country from the radical left.
---
[**Help Send CPT Brown to the Senate!**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678306%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=17BFXNX2pBTG7TCvusB0mg&sysid=1)
---
I wish I could take on the Democrat establishment on my own, and I wish I could beat their $100 million war chest by myself. **[But the simple fact is that I can’t do this without YOUR support, Friend. And with a HUGE end of quarter fundraising deadline just around the corner, I need your help more than ever.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678307%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FbnPZLobaZmI%2bNKZvWEXRg&sysid=1)** Duty First,
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678392%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5OWj5RAuIo1sAwurNg4Umg&sysid=1)
---
CPT Sam Brown, U.S. Army, Ret. P.S. Nevada is the nation’s most hotly contested battleground state and will likely decide the balance of power in the Senate AND who wins the Presidential election. That means I’m target number one for Joe Biden, the DNC, and the radical left’s billionaire best friends. The ONLY I know of to fight back is by enlisting the support of conservative patriots like YOU, Friend. **[Would you please consider rushing in an urgently needed End of Quarter donation?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678308%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bYJF9RzvT1NeIB2AYBx5zg&sysid=1)**

body:

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpdbuhtrles98ht9317ch8hhq5ms56lkac9shgv0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or1chh2bs)
---

Friend, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we've held more than 120 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

But, we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter deadline is here in just 2 days.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z75f1a67luiq38kmaknqohkgdco8701hit8bn290_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or1chh2bs "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter is here in just 2 days.")**_

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zscbg73cbhn868vrr0nejmkjir0nihd3pre1jnho_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or1chh2bs)
---

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

**[But, I need your help to make it happen. body:
My name is Sam Brown, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

| | |
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7t919h27ml7qu86f4erfk8moqr5nuaonuarceng_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)
---
Friend, I’ve written this letter to you and I really hope that you take a couple minutes to read it, but if you’re strapped for time, here are the highlights. My name is Sam Brown, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I was seriously injured while serving in Afghanistan, but in retrospect those injuries changed my life for the better and gave me the perspective I needed to become the man I am today. Today, I’m a husband, father, small businessman, and I’m the frontrunner for the Republican Senate nomination. Nevada will be the lynchpin state for both the U.S. Senate and the Presidential election in 2024. The most important fundraising deadline of the 2024 cycle is coming up. **[Would you consider rushing in $$ before our deadline?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zluful5ndvkvagigpmtpfaod9tvnfj7ug933bem0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)** _Now, here’s my story, Friend._
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr3oobrhf3m4hfmla9seifjje0nl39p0ls2oucpg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)
---
This is a picture of me and my father. I don’t remember a time when service to my family, my community, and my country wasn’t central to my plans for the future. My dad was the one who raised me to give my life to God and country. In highschool, I knew that joining the military was a key part of my career path. But after the 9/11 attacks, my desire to serve my country transformed from just a career path into an ironclad resolve and passion. A few years later, I graduated from West Point and was commissioned as an infantry officer. I answered the call from my country to fight in Afghanistan.
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmmhhifh6je72vugpe8g2cama4jcs12lmvlqk9p8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)
---
Four months into my deployment, my life changed in ways that I couldn’t have imagined. My team and I were on our way to provide support to an embattled platoon. On our way to the engagement zone, my team and ran over a roadside bomb. It all happened in an instant. The explosion soaked me in diesel and flames ignited all over my body. My gunner was able to put out the flames and save my life. If I’d been on fire for another minute I wouldn’t be writing this message to you today.
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbctpjfe7kkkp6g02dl1i89ig7rdfl3i1gtfl1u0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)
---
I was rushed back to a hospital in Texas where I’d undergo countless surgeries and 3 years of rehabilitation. I’m not telling you my story because I want you to pity me or see me as a hero. Certainly, I’m not the first or last person to be injured in the line of duty. **[I want you to know my story because I hope that it’ll give you confidence that I’m not a regular politician who will arrive in Washington D.C. and on day one and forget about the people I serve or those who’ve fought to defend our country.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj5f8v0kpjcq2ptlni574l1uclrosfneqshq66ig_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)** Friend, God’s plans for my life were far better than anything I could’ve come up with... And, in retrospect, my injuries weren’t the end of my life... Rather, they were the beginning of a new one. While recovering from my injuries, I met my wife Amy, and since then we’ve had 3 incredible children. While working a warehouse job, I built a business that gave me the opportunity to continue to serve Americans by sprinting around the red tape and providing emergency pharmaceutical care to veterans outside of the Veterans Health Administration. _**[Friend, if you help send me to the U.S. Senate, this is the exact attitude I will bring with me.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0qa1s7jqo177bjd3q4cs2uhg9itviead24vguog_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)**_ I will NEVER take your support for granted - and I won’t ever stop fighting to protect our country from the radical left.
---
[**Help Send CPT Brown to the Senate!**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsj7aq1ac1mu56hk11t00gfnlubjkk2lq9tbi1so_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)
---
I wish I could take on the Democrat establishment on my own, and I wish I could beat their $100 million war chest by myself. **[But the simple fact is that I can’t do this without YOUR support, Friend. And with a HUGE end of quarter fundraising deadline just around the corner, I need your help more than ever.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztvo6un40ouo9p4pi4v3l4558uceaakingldb3j8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)** Duty First,
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpimv5mm8m203v0elll8c4murios07spp0i7ma6g_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)
---
CPT Sam Brown,U.S. Army, Ret. P.S. Nevada is the nation’s most hotly contested battleground state and will likely decide the balance of power in the Senate AND who wins the Presidential election. That means I’m target number one for Joe Biden, the DNC, and the radical left’s billionaire best friends. The ONLY I know of to fight back is by enlisting the support of conservative patriots like YOU, Friend. **[Would you please consider rushing in an urgently needed End of Quarter donation?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zs84ihi4m4i2hidhil6fsuus4e2f4ook08jcb8h0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jm8or6clh2bs)**

I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678315%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gtkZLhG3y0t%2fmtdSGYvUGg&sysid=1)
---

Friend, I took the stage at the second Republican presidential primary debate on September 27th to fight tooth and nail for our country, our freedom, our future, and your children because I know one thing to be true: _America is**suffering** , and it’s up to US to change course._ **I have good news:** we’re one step closer to defeating Joe Biden and dismantling the woke indoctrination that’s run rampant across this country after we dominated on the debate stage. No excuses. Once again, we got the job done. Now, it’s time to kick up the intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who I am and who I’m fighting for so you can join me in this critical race.
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678315%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gtkZLhG3y0t%2fmtdSGYvUGg&sysid=1)
---
I’m a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678315%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gtkZLhG3y0t%2fmtdSGYvUGg&sysid=1)
---
After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I’ve watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.
---

---
I have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.
---

As Governor of Florida, I’ve made it my mission to lead with conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought they deserved the power to control American lives, and we benefitted because of it. **Leadership matters.** We’ve set the example in Florida. But if we don’t get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they’ve caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. But we can’t win unless we come together and defeat Joe Biden next November. I want you to know, Friend: I am not running to be President, I am running to get things done as President. **Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024:_Freedom or Decline._**_ _ I made my case for the choice I need you to make with me on that debate stage in California. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I will continue to show up and take this vision of our Great American Comeback directly to you, as a Presidential candidate should.

In Freedom,

https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=c58c59230b563f9897df2d0262d6fbce06e3f92c9079c7898b3eb1a8f8e6f5d7315530e1c3dd5d5f04b3295141d6bce06d83d3ae386d92a9c823c51291c9bee52a74285d45a2af2e0238cc2018880967

Peter,

Look around.

Millions of Illegals are waltzing across our border while the door is held open for them.

Our cities are collapsing under the weight and swarming with crime.

Mothers are losing their children to fentanyl poisoning.

Democrat Governors are finally admitting this is a crisis and calling on the National Guard.

Children are being told to memorize sexually-explicit garbage in schools.

Biden is saluting a Pride flag on the White House Lawn.

The lie that men can get pregnant is being shoved down the throats of kids.

Women and girls—my daughters—are losing the chance to compete in sports fairly.

Parents are losing their rights to raise their kids as they see fit and choose what school is best for them.

Families are struggling to put food on the table because Biden has prioritized the benefit of the elite class and bent the knee to the woke mob by embracing environmental, social governance mandates over the DIRE needs of average Americans.

Why am I running for President, Peter? This is why.

September 29, 2023

Hi Friend --

It's almost spooky season! 👻🎃

The Biden-Baldwin Agenda, which has resulted in sky-high prices, an uncontrollable border crisis, and rising crime, has made every day seem like a nightmare.

Despite the Democrats' horrifying agenda, Wisconsin Republicans are determined to deliver treats this season.

Read our latest update below!

-Team WisGOP

Republicans have been hard at work introducing legislation that represents the values of Wisconsin.

>From fighting to put money back into the pockets of hard-working Wisconsinites to protecting our youth, Republican legislators refuse to abandon your rights. Read below for an overview of some new legislation!

Wisconsin Representatives Scott Allen and Robin Vos, along with Senator Duey Stroebel introduced the Help Not Harm Act [https://www.wkow.com/news/wisconsin-republicans-introduce-bill-banning-transitional-treatment-for-minors/article_3713e11a-5d71-11ee-8c16-237a034f0ea0.html]

This bill aims to protect minors from gender-transitioning medical intervention, including hormone therapy, mastectomies, sterilization, etc.

Legislative Republicans introduced a few constitutional amendment [https://thefederalist.com/2023/09/26/wisconsin-republicans-introduce-measures-to-withdraw-state-from-eric-ban-zuckbucks-in-elections/#:~:text=Wisconsin%20Republicans%20Introduce%20Measures%20To,%2C%20Ban%20'Zuckbucks'%20In%20Elections&text=The%20allowance%20of%20private%20money,and%20it%20needs%20to%20stop] s [https://thefederalist.com/2023/09/26/wisconsin-republicans-introduce-measures-to-withdraw-state-from-eric-ban-zuckbucks-in-elections/#:~:text=Wisconsin%20Republicans%20Introduce%20Measures%20To,%2C%20Ban%20'Zuckbucks'%20In%20Elections&text=The%20allowance%20of%20private%20money,and%20it%20needs%20to%20stop]. The various amendments would ban outside, dark money known as “Zuckerbucks" from Wisconsin elections, protect voter ID [https://www.thecentersquare.com/wisconsin/article_0d289130-5bd6-11ee-ae06-a3cce62e7d0e.html], and withdraw Wisconsin from “ERIC."

Senators Van Wanggaard and James and Representatives Callahan and Spiros also authored a bill to install early gun detection systems [https://madison.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/wisconsin-guns-schools/article_916fc360-5c89-11ee-ac47-bbe413fceaa1.html#:~:text=Schools%20around%20Wisconsin%20could%20seek,help%20head%20off%20school%20shootings] in schools. Our legislators believe that this proactive measure will allow schools to advance their security coverage and provide more protection for our students while protecting 2A rights.

The Republican Party of Wisconsin is thrilled to announce the launch of our groundbreaking Grassroots Training Program, which will build upon the success of recent cycles.

>From flipping the Kenosha County Executive [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/kenosha-county-flips-red-democratic-leadership] to the Wausau School Board [https://apnews.com/article/2022-midterm-elections-covid-health-education-rebecca-kleefisch-d331a34493722dd0844a701f9b66a246], working with center-right-minded Wisconsinites is the key to sparking change at the local level.

This program aims to equip individuals with the skills, knowledge, and resources needed to drive positive change at the local level.

Assembly Republicans recently introduced a sweeping redistricting reform plan that would allocate the power of redistricting to a nonpartisan committee. The move calls the Democrats’ bluff over redistricting reform, and predictably, Governor Tony Evers called the proposal "bogus," despite its near-identical resemblance to a plan Democrats have supported for years. The message from the Democrats is clear: it was never about more “fair” maps—it’s about power and tilting the landscape in favor or the Dems.

In light of Justice Janet Protasiewicz's comments, Republican legislators proposed an alternative path forward, "fair maps." The hypocrisy from Wisconsin Democrats has not gone unnoticed. Even the liberal Wisconsin State Journal editorial board called [https://madison.com/opinion/editorial/robin-vos-iowa-model-gerrymandering/article_ec47d360-5264-11ee-bba9-3fa39500dd6b.html]their behavior "disappointing." Again, Wisconsin Democrats are saying the quiet part out loud: they don't want fair maps. Rather than work with Republicans to best serve the interests of Wisconsinites, as they have claimed they have wanted to do all these years, Democrats are turning to Protasiewicz to help them weaponize the State Supreme Court as the vehicle for their liberal political agenda.

"Bidenomics" is a brand that is falling flat with voters; Republicans know it, and so do Democrats [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/09/29/white-house-bidenomics-failure-00118949]. Dozens of polling has shown that the White House’s false portrayal of a “booming” economy is not resonating with the public. Hundreds of big cities nationwide have lost jobs and seen wages cut, including in Wisconsin [https://apnews.com/article/2022-midterm-elections-covid-health-education-rebecca-kleefisch-d331a34493722dd0844a701f9b66a246]. I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23437%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kDzDSoXHmBPwRNLG1r0FzQ&sysid=1)
---

Friend, I took the stage at the second Republican presidential primary debate on September 27th to fight tooth and nail for our country, our freedom, our future, and your children because I know one thing to be true: _America is**suffering** , and it’s up to US to change course._ **I have good news:** we’re one step closer to defeating Joe Biden and dismantling the woke indoctrination that’s run rampant across this country after we dominated on the debate stage. No excuses. Once again, we got the job done. Now, it’s time to kick up the intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who I am and who I’m fighting for so you can join me in this critical race.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23437%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kDzDSoXHmBPwRNLG1r0FzQ&sysid=1)
---
I’m a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23437%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kDzDSoXHmBPwRNLG1r0FzQ&sysid=1)
---
After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I’ve watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23437%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kDzDSoXHmBPwRNLG1r0FzQ&sysid=1)
---
I have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.
---

As Governor of Florida, I’ve made it my mission to lead with conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought they deserved the power to control American lives, and we benefitted because of it. **Leadership matters.** We’ve set the example in Florida. But if we don’t get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they’ve caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. But we can’t win unless we come together and defeat Joe Biden next November. I want you to know, Friend: I am not running to be President, I am running to get things done as President. **Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024:_Freedom or Decline._**_ _ I made my case for the choice I need you to make with me on that debate stage in California. body:
My name is Sam Brown, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

| | |
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgshcrd8dor0ecps0ihf3j38ftjt25dmv1ihraso_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)
---
Friend, I’ve written this letter to you and I really hope that you take a couple minutes to read it, but if you’re strapped for time, here are the highlights. My name is Sam Brown, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I was seriously injured while serving in Afghanistan, but in retrospect those injuries changed my life for the better and gave me the perspective I needed to become the man I am today. Today, I’m a husband, father, small businessman, and I’m the frontrunner for the Republican Senate nomination. Nevada will be the lynchpin state for both the U.S. Senate and the Presidential election in 2024. The most important fundraising deadline of the 2024 cycle is coming up. **[Would you consider rushing in $$ before our deadline?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdlsqc1fgstkk8b25qmfapdcqk2vbi63nsi0s1fg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)** _Now, here’s my story, Friend._
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmf1fgtb6pvnau6uljtv5a8pnmqa9ot063p3sglg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)
---
This is a picture of me and my father. I don’t remember a time when service to my family, my community, and my country wasn’t central to my plans for the future. My dad was the one who raised me to give my life to God and country. In highschool, I knew that joining the military was a key part of my career path. But after the 9/11 attacks, my desire to serve my country transformed from just a career path into an ironclad resolve and passion. A few years later, I graduated from West Point and was commissioned as an infantry officer. I answered the call from my country to fight in Afghanistan.
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5rnl6vlc8sde1lik4pu6rqk1jtvbag31mqvka0g_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)
---
Four months into my deployment, my life changed in ways that I couldn’t have imagined. My team and I were on our way to provide support to an embattled platoon. On our way to the engagement zone, my team and ran over a roadside bomb. It all happened in an instant. The explosion soaked me in diesel and flames ignited all over my body. My gunner was able to put out the flames and save my life. If I’d been on fire for another minute I wouldn’t be writing this message to you today.
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6onau37nddrg51eo4o0ahn2pg9oq0aqpd34nuk0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)
---
I was rushed back to a hospital in Texas where I’d undergo countless surgeries and 3 years of rehabilitation. I’m not telling you my story because I want you to pity me or see me as a hero. Certainly, I’m not the first or last person to be injured in the line of duty. **[I want you to know my story because I hope that it’ll give you confidence that I’m not a regular politician who will arrive in Washington D.C. and on day one and forget about the people I serve or those who’ve fought to defend our country.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znvs3pavvd4infq01ebnnuturpb4vp82hk4k3tmg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)** Friend, God’s plans for my life were far better than anything I could’ve come up with... And, in retrospect, my injuries weren’t the end of my life... Rather, they were the beginning of a new one. While recovering from my injuries, I met my wife Amy, and since then we’ve had 3 incredible children. While working a warehouse job, I built a business that gave me the opportunity to continue to serve Americans by sprinting around the red tape and providing emergency pharmaceutical care to veterans outside of the Veterans Health Administration. _**[Friend, if you help send me to the U.S. Senate, this is the exact attitude I will bring with me.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd0u2k12827ffa81kup6b5rc4jiu2n1vobthdpt8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)**_ I will NEVER take your support for granted - and I won’t ever stop fighting to protect our country from the radical left.
---
[**Help Send CPT Brown to the Senate!**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znoai7jqno2cumjjj7dako4bkl1ppb2qj59g4st8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)
---
I wish I could take on the Democrat establishment on my own, and I wish I could beat their $100 million war chest by myself. **[But the simple fact is that I can’t do this without YOUR support, Friend. And with a HUGE end of quarter fundraising deadline just around the corner, I need your help more than ever.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z21tom96k09r8pu1i8osnbr0ln7ko1fjebar59v0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)** Duty First,
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6pki3f4dtsdshpqfjdr37b4g7d4qhf4nmp7g810_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)
---
CPT Sam Brown,U.S. Army, Ret. P.S. Nevada is the nation’s most hotly contested battleground state and will likely decide the balance of power in the Senate AND who wins the Presidential election. That means I’m target number one for Joe Biden, the DNC, and the radical left’s billionaire best friends. The ONLY I know of to fight back is by enlisting the support of conservative patriots like YOU, Friend. **[Would you please consider rushing in an urgently needed End of Quarter donation?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zate9ifr5dsflbbvgt0p6dcrbc9qvijjln354i38_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32chh2bs)**
