subject: Will you chip in before the quarter ends on Saturday?
body:
We still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv3ft4q83mttknocbtc9ji33a9iiupkbkmhf9an8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32cth2bs)
---

Friend, can I share something important with you?

Over the last six months we've held more than 120 campaign events across the country, met with thousands of voters, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **SECOND** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.

But, we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

_**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter deadline is here in just 2 days.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zii7voltp65io39cru61emdpdoq591fjlltqt24g_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32cth2bs "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially before my FEC end-of-quarter is here in just 2 days.")**_

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjfqp8820js7e4d4n3hjs0i6hlvs8cvr4lhftoc8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1jmeo32cth2bs)
---

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

**[But, I need your help to make it happen. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zaq6n6mp2oiigh49m514ui1pvl1to1b2mpu5ds10_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---

Friend, I took the stage at the second Republican presidential primary debate on September 27th to fight tooth and nail for our country, our freedom, our future, and your children because I know one thing to be true: _America is**suffering** , and it's up to US to change course._ **I have good news:** we're one step closer to defeating Joe Biden and dismantling the woke indoctrination that's run rampant across this country after we dominated on the debate stage. No excuses. Once again, we got the job done. Now, it's time to kick up the intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who I am and who I'm fighting for so you can join me in this critical race.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgqcqkopvn99m79o401kkv0patg7evp6agcf9p5o_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
I'm a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoftt36bupum5qjddrtv99f2obdejktbu1uj0jag_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I've watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgb4c0fes7gslmht034nab4dge27jcvfa0tgn0to_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
I have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.
---
| | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4tjudklteovjtsob5fjif6to8788tsvm08ssdfg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlqscijbt2d4f6ilt75kn772qqfjg6f3k1nrrnu0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
| | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8p02qirrcs12kp263tsgcq7k65r3c7tttdn6b08_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvvaqh89977c1go36trkq01tilpipt3r1obspu8g_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
| | [This is my vision for America. Help make it a reality > CHIP IN $10](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg09o5ts9caomcouberp54djo6u1kit9tqqt7tj0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
As Governor of Florida, I've made it my mission to lead with conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought they deserved the power to control American lives, and we benefitted because of it. **Leadership matters.** We've set the example in Florida. But if we don't get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they've caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. But we can't win unless we come together and defeat Joe Biden next November. I want you to know, Friend: I am not running to be President, I am running to get things done as President. **Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024:_Freedom or Decline._**_ _ I made my case for the choice I need you to make with me on that debate stage in California. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I will continue to show up and take this vision of our Great American Comeback directly to you, as a Presidential candidate should.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdcf96r20otlpfvs69qm0inlolrmqrh33elkll8o_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---
I will never back down from being your voice and your fighter. Please, join me in fighting for the future--because freedom is always worth fighting for.

In Freedom,
---

_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zatgcuvn3q9jgj1a636i8d2ov7kq3idqj26rpono_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zj8t9qp77g20cgopjaibsetgk00l57ja1t3qmog0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge0or2c1h2bs)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

---

## Federal Government on Brink of Shutdown
House Speaker Kevin McCarthy failed to get a [stopgap bill](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvozAQhH-N6Rwtu7YJBcVJJ7pceyUCvMC-GBthJ9H7909J_boZTTEz3__bcBslSFz_jTt3ZUnDOBd58gCtJtBIA1a-W5iRqeKudq2DxjpXV1s3NxatncjhZKw3k10awgb86LyBa20q6RCQoCWA1hoyF3RUN862C12pBXDKAHsp6bx8JYll4yV8pyeflzntVei2Uo6s6I_CXmFfNt4khHemsN_SzpFf-SMfmRX2Bgno6vTH6znFzOdzfL_Juozxrtd06Lyls-jC566XR_QSVz1JCO8K6uUQr-jvcaY96SDxrqeQ5ntdnZ0_XhKCZNcoA-s-ymdIVX5n9hMAAP__iDptGg) passed on Friday--a measure that would have funded the government until the end of October, albeit with 30% cuts to non-defense spending. The deadline [to pass a budget](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D1vhiAcBPBPgxuGF0UZGLq4PV07GoS_QoNgeHlMv31j5653yeWX-3qtL-2Dj8enPkHVPa3aVP-GlUjMCWZ8ZZ1VOwAD3oGiQgoyjULQzql5nrme-USpmEZONkEt3azYxLAxYzbTecUI40RyQuQ48KFngtNJjHLnM5eECDQQsL6m3H8nH6uDPfykN-TepLMLytV6FcQ_EFsQW-777jO0Crk8_ZOkHCxiSyuILU5nG3wEnOFqW_BGR-xSsKnVgq9WHG4FH896PCFWbEIqkHFxrdp0R_xQMZGYScSWLit73T4EX8SEBnKc2oc_Vf3_pN8AAAD__xDGaKE) is tonight, and the death of yesterday's bill means that a government shutdown is imminent. [Twenty-one](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGSpCAUAL9GMywGlJHA4BKzufRCC-Eh7wrBgqfu_P3WbLxxB93V_17Ly2DEtP01O0zk82Is4QUL10xyJuQiWjd5AAGyhemhtOLPQalHGyY3eqEGp9WqvPbGj0KP3vZ6hcEOdlhbnAQXkmvJuR562XdCycdTDdrLUWrOVdNzcEi5dP8zJgrg4ztfUDqb9zZOgeiojfzTiLkR833fnc9fCe764Y2YjxyR0NZGzAEKMFOAhXxWYAWOc41oTarsygSOpcx2a02h8K6sUj42czB_JodpYyvGyMwFhdj28acdErEaTnL5Tm2Z3HFjjFjVs-n5thuMP4n0-7HvAAAA__9ztnFt) Republicans voted against the stopgap, citing concerns about funding for the war in Ukraine and southern border security.

_"I think it 's pretty safe to say that tomorrow at midnight, you know, the lights are gonna go out for a while," _Rep. Steve Womack (R-AR) told reporters after a meeting.
## Senator Feinstein Dead at 90
Senator Dianne Feinstein (D-CA) [died](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFuwzAMAF9jbw5oUpalQUOXbOna0aAlKmGhyIEtJOjvi3TueLjhgPu6LBfWovX6yXcJLW8Lx6ZPWcAPBAPSgn0KWQSFegmj9RbmydqxvwXLICY7xrj6ESa7QnKjALBdZ-8o9RoQkMATgJ8MmRNaGmc7-UyOPIDtDEjStu2n701ru0kuP9tT9lPc7n0Jt9YeR0cfHZ47PPOjyut4qzfsTWORDs9JuVYZsmg9mmgdknAaoqMxE6LjaExm9nYiJDPNsK4uiu_3kB4vLUUPO3cGrnfW8pdt_1_4DQAA__8Z51sH) on Thursday night. She was the oldest member of the Senate and its longest-serving woman. Before her Senate career began in 1992, she served as the first female mayor of San Francisco.

Feinstein [was known](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO8yAQBOCnwR3WstgkFBR_4y5_e6VF8BLvyYYISKy8_clXXznSJ81ovm7zzfPG6fHf7-RazLMPjd80g5UaJOoZu8VFIiTdkVPGGriMxqhudRQXMxIFuBLGMIZBKbgqBOVhuNP93rFDQA1WA9hx0EOPRquLGW3UV20BjBiAFm659N-ZU1spbp_8ptKHvHebW1t7VqH_CZwETsdx9G2lx8uXhX06jcDpVWWiowqczi6BU6XnGazA6WSJZCROtREnGXwhKrL6JGPxKXANWe7-k4v0vFRZKflGXXHL8-Bt42ouYoDH7nn7ndT-fugnAAD__8_FZ6M) as a fierce proponent of gun control, abortion rights, and environmentalism, and she referred to the assault weapons ban of 1994 as one of her most important accomplishments. The Senator missed over two months of work this year as she battled shingles--causing much consternation as the Democratic Senate majority ceased in her absence. She eventually announced that she would not seek reelection.

California Governor Gavin Newsome is [expected to announce](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn-NvRGdOXM2A0OXbOna0brAEVNhY2GUqP--SueOn743PL2v23LjlNP--ORNXItlYd_SUxawCkFpXHQfXBTRgr24gSzBZIiGfnXBGj8FCN5Gmq3384jBaEKL_j4CmT45DRrBIoA1I44XTThMZGzEGS0AdSNISK3Uy3dJe1sl5p_ylHrxZeuzW1s7zg4_On3t9JWPXV7n-3qP2pLP0ulrlLSfTdKuqhyZvWyyN_VGy6aCbMVXbioIt1UZPd-NYTYQgJjRwnAfyA_aMmMU6KsLxyvlnE6auhEeG6f8J9P-b_MbAAD__wPwY-M) a temporary replacement soon.
## New York City Flooded
A record-breaking downpour of rain [fell on New York City](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL9G6vAcHDqsguI17vzalBoMh0WCwIOINf77jFOn3NlmZz-uy9WlnMr9v9vY9lgX53t68gKzQBAKFzUGG5kV48hW0kxgJiI5rhY9G54MBSYJYdJGxXNU7FFGDjH6MVkFCmFGgHnSqE-KUBqa5ohnnAFo0MAh9dpOnzWVvnLMr_rkdvJ1G7Nde3_sA_4b1GVQF_cofOxv9YbWk888qEupra_s9i72XtsmmktFFD7Eq7YvEXOtIZW72L9vh3sJJ8kFbRRwCIE8RMMOb4Zk1FLzGcZmw-NIOaedzKDhvrmUf3P633d-AgAA___PXWYJ) yesterday. Roadways, apartments, and subways were flooded, and the public transit system was widely interrupted.

Seven inches of rain fell in Brooklyn, and John F. Kennedy airport shut down one of its terminals as it was hit with 8.65 inches--the most ever recorded there.

[The deluge](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO6yAQheGnwR3WMIMhFBS3cZfbbmk5eOywSyCyia28_SrZLbf7pa85Oh_n4TzGFPPyf7yxr3MZxlDjzgM4SSCRBmwmPzMjU8NeGWfAdsao5upnwqAujh2eAllAZdlYpbRlDRT01ESPgASOAFynSbdoSFnTuZlO5ACM0MBTrGVtP0vM9cpzepad1zaUW5P8tdb7JuifwF5gfxxHmy8h87G9XGD_SoH9Y5O_leLO8pLK8oPyWdYvOadSppgX-dbHfRorb3INeVTqBF3XrH66HzGluBkrNCy3Mab3gvr3Id8BAAD__2p0YMA) was a remnant of Tropical Storm Ophelia, and Governor Kathy Hochul declared a state of emergency in response.

A sea lion made the best of the situation by escaping from its flooded pool at the Central Park Zoo. It eventually came back, but not before being [captured on video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu6zAMAL9G2hJQpExZg4a3eMtbOxpKTMUq5Diw2Rj9-6Lt2u2AGw73dhkvubb6uP_PiyQt65hvWl8yQjwRnJBGtFMqIihkJTmODKFjdnZO0UcvDolKl30IhF0BuDKSyzmG_mprQkCCSACx8-TPyOQCd7FQTxGAjQeZqq7b-X2tD52ltM_1Jdv5ti62pVn1uRv6Z3AwOOhRVX-dwWHLx56bbLobHHbN-vENLkDoA_cR-0CBIwLbLU3Po7ZWdw7Gw33Jtf0E9O_frwAAAP__zn9Slw) and going viral.

body:
I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5brrnshesgvuog9slbb3vhp4doh3prkustric40_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge4ob4c5h2bs)
---

Friend, I took the stage at the second Republican presidential primary debate on September 27th to fight tooth and nail for our country, our freedom, our future, and your children because I know one thing to be true: _America is**suffering** , and it's up to US to change course._ **I have good news:** we're one step closer to defeating Joe Biden and dismantling the woke indoctrination that's run rampant across this country after we dominated on the debate stage. No excuses. Once again, we got the job done. Now, it's time to kick up the intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who I am and who I'm fighting for so you can join me in this critical race.
---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zpvr1rvub4k51hb8vcv8hko1dkgfbd0ia1mmdg70_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge4ob4c5h2bs)
---
I'm a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z086j3049rs0v2s0bugfem8rlk1bvhmbsns0cgn8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge4ob4c5h2bs)
---
After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I've watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.
---
| [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z4vi6eurqt9luairh4d95idnn6hqndh5ih4ukr9g_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge4ob4c5h2bs)
---
I have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.
---
| | | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsps63lrsl1ad8ers15u9kt837ju6q89rpfret7g_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge4ob4c5h2bs)

| | | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z1v8rjchj6os2agjoasck09tfid5rh50s8e5m4cg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge4ob4c5h2bs)
---
| | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zncnap55cjksd0vqkbgg0phq3u4uml955ejbjqk0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge4ob4c5h2bs)
---
| | [This is my vision for America. Help make it a reality > CHIP IN $10](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zebtunj2f4f58jhprqv7elmmpluviv7tgoaebdcg_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge4ob4c5h2bs)
---
As Governor of Florida, I've made it my mission to lead with conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought they deserved the power to control American lives, and we benefitted because of it. **Leadership matters.** We've set the example in Florida. But if we don't get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they've caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. But we can't win unless we come together and defeat Joe Biden next November. I want you to know, Friend: I am not running to be President, I am running to get things done as President. **Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024:_Freedom or Decline._**_ _ I made my case for the choice I need you to make with me on that debate stage in California. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I will continue to show up and take this vision of our Great American Comeback directly to you, as a Presidential candidate should.
---

---
I will never back down from being your voice and your fighter. Please, join me in fighting for the future--because freedom is always worth fighting for.

In Freedom,

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

But after the 9/11 attacks, my desire to serve my country transformed from just a career path into an ironclad resolve and passion. A few years later, I graduated from West Point and was commissioned as an infantry officer. I answered the call from my country to fight in Afghanistan.

body:
I’d like to make sure you know what I’m fighting for and who I am.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zfnj5mqe79qcdrgfmgif2gftlldpufotnm2utoug_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---

Friend, I took the stage at the second Republican presidential primary debate on September 27th to fight tooth and nail for our country, our freedom, our future, and your children because I know one thing to be true: _America is**suffering** , and it's up to US to change course._ **I have good news:** we're one step closer to defeating Joe Biden and dismantling the woke indoctrination that's run rampant across this country after we dominated on the debate stage. No excuses. Once again, we got the job done. Now, it's time to kick up the intensity of this campaign, and I need to make sure you know who I am and who I'm fighting for so you can join me in this critical race.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zge8hb4sqncojngejavntpult6lu2pdlhdi6cmho_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
I'm a blue-collar kid from Florida who worked to pay my way through college and law school in the years leading up to 9/11. After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8mjeumeupfsv2m10d11pfv8hgeddseqnog2q9v0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I've watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0re3enn0icpcj15relpvtpnqlool27kidlk8qo0_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
I have plans to rip up every failing policy and get to work reversing the decline of our country. On Day One as President, I am pledging to usher in a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. I will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7rgthab7p6p8hrq253qqk9nnqbq5m9sr8eki5k8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
| | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z3hpje0e060lce1rap2rvbbsh602a0erc027kkr8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4r742m37m11gt32u15l2brbthqrtb2oiha1vl98_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
| | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z60jn234sui3ka9ko58e5l11ctekmms6o3d03368_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
| | [This is my vision for America. Help make it a reality > CHIP IN $10](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7k8o2185f5q6dg21qlupa5a3oipblbebcnma72o_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
As Governor of Florida, I've made it my mission to lead with conviction, stand firm in the truth, and never back down from fighting for the people I serve, especially when Covid-19 caused commonsense to become an uncommon virtue across our country. We refused to bend the knee to unelected bureaucrats who thought they deserved the power to control American lives, and we benefitted because of it. **Leadership matters.** We've set the example in Florida. But if we don't get our entire country back on track now, we risk letting the Left lead our country down a deeper path of decline for four more years. I believe we can come back from the harm they've caused to our country so far, but we have to act.

Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. But we can't win unless we come together and defeat Joe Biden next November. I want you to know, Friend: I am not running to be President, I am running to get things done as President. **Our nation is facing a critical choice in 2024:_Freedom or Decline._**_ _ I made my case for the choice I need you to make with me on that debate stage in California. I know that no one is entitled to anything in this world, so I will continue to show up and take this vision of our Great American Comeback directly to you, as a Presidential candidate should.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zc5r3queup4ohi3gmj60td1c4p97bo4p23v6q57o_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---
I will never back down from being your voice and your fighter. Please, join me in fighting for the future--because freedom is always worth fighting for.

In Freedom,
---

_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0tvsiqovsdo9r8rhqf4o6q936h0k0mphnn73th8_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1sj884s4q6cno22i8uf26f6kmg89t9qq83geg28_rp22sh2s8i66p73c1ge2oj4c9h2bs)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

---

body:

---|---|---

| | _**BREAKING NEWS**_ : **The Biden Administration has CANCELED all existing oil and gas leases in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge!** This is great news, Friend – **BUT the new proposed rules still have some serious gaps** , including the possibility of new developments in the Refuge. You have a chance to ensure the Administration meets the threshold to fully protect the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge, **but the comment period before these changes go into effect is closing fast!** [_**Send in your comment now!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2023254?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) Here are two of the major concerns that remain: The Administration has not acknowledged the impact on the subsistence for the Indigenous Gwich’in people. Without properly addressing this concern, their way of life is **STILL UNDER THREAT** from development in the Arctic. There is still insufficient study on the effects of**polar bears** and **caribou** in the region. The Arctic is warming **TWICE AS FAST** as the rest of the world, and these species are in serious danger! [_**Please, Friend, will you tell President Biden to oppose development in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge and strengthen his actions to protect the Arctic?**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2023255?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ***274 more signatures needed from your area*** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2023256?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
President Biden also announced new rules for Alaska’s National Petroleum Reserve. This is the single largest unit of public lands in the country, spanning nearly 23 million acres. It includes **critical habitat** for migratory **birds, brown bears, threatened polar bears, walruses, and more.** But once again, **these protections don’t go far enough.** We need to ensure there are ZERO loopholes for allowing new oil and gas developments, like the approved Willow Project, which could cause irreparable harm.
The Arctic is on the frontlines of the climate crisis. Both the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge and the National Petroleum Reserve need new protections. Your message to President Biden can help ensure we implement his new protections – and go even further. _**But we’re running out of time!**_
[_**Stop greedy developers from DESTROYING the Arctic! Tell President Biden to protect this critical region before it’s too late. >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2023257?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2023258?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Raena Garcia

subject: Share Inslee’s resume!
body:
Jay Inslee's taxpayer-funded trips are not solely for climate change purposes; he is actively seeking his next job. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62308014:We_tQNiNH:m:1:2610672541:8F391586080DD2D0D895042542792B23:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends, Recently, Shift WA was feeling rather generous towards Jay Inslee. Perhaps it's because he spared us all from yet another failed term as governor by announcing he would not seek re-election. Or, perhaps it's because we saw his most recent doodling. Whatever the reason, to help him in his job search, we took it upon ourselves to create a resume for to help him find something the suits his "talents". We wanted Inslee's resume to highlight his environmental "achievements" as governor of our state. Our aim is to tell the truth about his track record - even if Jay won't do so himself - so he can find the best fit. We urge you to help us spread the word by sharing Inslee's resume far and wide. Your support is crucial in making sure the voters know the truth about Inslee's record. **_[Please consider making a contribution today of $100, $50, or $25 to help us achieve this goal!

](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62308015:We_tQNiNH:m:1:2610672541:8F391586080DD2D0D895042542792B23:r)_** Recently, we highlighted Inslee's trip to the United Nations, where he and his wife traveled to deliver a brief four-minute speech on climate change. Rather than utilizing Zoom, Inslee emitted a staggering 5,400 pounds of CO2 for a speech that could easily have been delivered from home. But it's clear that Inslee's taxpayer-funded trips are not solely for climate change purposes; he is actively seeking his next job. Although he won't be running for re-election, he has no qualms about using taxpayers' hard-earned money to further his personal job search. We need your help to ensure voters know about Inslee's hypocrisy and self-serving agenda. [**Will you consider contributing today?**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62308015:We_tQNiNH:m:1:2610672541:8F391586080DD2D0D895042542792B23:r) [**Currently, we are still behind our monthly goal by over $700. Will you help us close the gap and make a difference today?**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62308015:We_tQNiNH:m:1:2610672541:8F391586080DD2D0D895042542792B23:r) Thank you, The Shift WA team | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62308016:We_tQNiNH:m:1:2610672541:8F391586080DD2D0D895042542792B23:r)

body:
My name is Sam Brown, I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

| | |
---
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=851c2df024da494f81c6d68eb71bf5ee&_e=0JyR3VMSFsDMFhMW8khbunzDr1zKq617Ve8PVnCGkBBDDDLKo01mQA8ZXpD47Ajxjlp-tk8jHjMvteOFDkRCEY8rJap1twJIBilvoiYV3yyUnyDC_tpIQ7uwOehOijiaR_pbqVKOESCobLgxgxjVGz5-N4KB_hjA7K_JttH-AA42_ICiVsWO3TbK49I0KpQ-4dZLoB-05f3bt-6VQOMlOFvbkZgkn30h8jw1rQODYDB10-4JSweK_bSbMVNvegFt_5fgNP0WHgvo5GxwFWwQX-_x3qC7SjECFoV8CjO215mb_yllNZIR8fTvOm68Yz--0y8lDZWslW9Dcw2tZt496kS9Iq5SE8-0rU8crPYdz_-HV2o5aH_m4ZbX5J88a9UaZZAiJ9z8JUk9oK740eik5V7PVB7pR8EttFaoyHTnh30%3D)
---
Friend, I've written this letter to you and I really hope that you take a couple minutes to read it, but if you're strapped for time, here are the highlights. My name is Sam Brown, I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I was seriously injured while serving in Afghanistan, but in retrospect those injuries changed my life for the better and gave me the perspective I needed to become the man I am today. Today, I'm a husband, father, small businessman, and I'm the frontrunner for the Republican Senate nomination. Nevada will be the lynchpin state for both the U.S. Senate and the Presidential election in 2024. The most important fundraising deadline of the 2024 cycle is coming up. **[Would you consider rushing in $$ before our deadline?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=851c2df024da494f81c6d68eb71bf5ee&_e=0JyR3VMSFsDMFhMW8khbunzDr1zKq617Ve8PVnCGkBBDDDLKo01mQA8ZXpD47Ajxjlp-tk8jHjMvteOFDkRCEY8rJap1twJIBilvoiYV3yyUnyDC_tpIQ7uwOehOijiaR_pbqVKOESCobLgxgxjVGz5-N4KB_hjA7K_JttH-AA42_ICiVsWO3TbK49I0KpQ-4dZLoB-05f3bt-6VQOMlOFvbkZgkn30h8jw1rQODYDB10-4JSweK_bSbMVNvegFt_5fgNP0WHgvo5GxwFWwQX37mX1GMH0BO7VqYXtQfdi_Uy98DX0STVXz90uCmksEo7sjTtHFV3_Zdk41gBQzjyetCfpvmINiYAsa1AOzu-70UzmmgDwBemJFlEaI2gk8PJPP7qb-vaJCjNDStMqhN4MtW88RxwGVLwaRxx3pTAt8%3D)** _Now, here 's my story, Friend._
---
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=851c2df024da494f81c6d68eb71bf5ee&_e=0JyR3VMSFsDMFhMW8khbunzDr1zKq617Ve8PVnCGkBBDDDLKo01mQA8ZXpD47Ajxjlp-tk8jHjMvteOFDkRCEY8rJap1twJIBilvoiYV3yyUnyDC_tpIQ7uwOehOijiaR_pbqVKOESCobLgxgxjVGz5-N4KB_hjA7K_JttH-AA42_ICiVsWO3TbK49I0KpQ-4dZLoB-05f3bt-6VQOMlOFvbkZgkn30h8jw1rQODYDB10-4JSweK_bSbMVNvegFt_5fgNP0WHgvo5GxwFWwQXz12QG-bZbNCnV2jx-8FzdlamZw4Omya2G6XEX2q3ym9hnYyjYOcdRpmoGIOwnxdhFi7z7DivDQRiPE6y-JqTn6PYEkxR8g7pRlZJKPOr6dAnuIu1_TG9luXtU9RM5ar4c28Az20LlhuzFk8F_OLYlM%3D)
---
This is a picture of me and my father. I don't remember a time when service to my family, my community, and my country wasn't central to my plans for the future. My dad was the one who raised me to give my life to God and country. In highschool, I knew that joining the military was a key part of my career path. But after the 9/11 attacks, my desire to serve my country transformed from just a career path into an ironclad resolve and passion. A few years later, I graduated from West Point and was commissioned as an infantry officer. I answered the call from my country to fight in Afghanistan.
---
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=851c2df024da494f81c6d68eb71bf5ee&_e=0JyR3VMSFsDMFhMW8khbunzDr1zKq617Ve8PVnCGkBBDDDLKo01mQA8ZXpD47Ajxjlp-tk8jHjMvteOFDkRCEY8rJap1twJIBilvoiYV3yyUnyDC_tpIQ7uwOehOijiaR_pbqVKOESCobLgxgxjVGz5-N4KB_hjA7K_JttH-AA42_ICiVsWO3TbK49I0KpQ-4dZLoB-05f3bt-6VQOMlOFvbkZgkn30h8jw1rQODYDB10-4JSweK_bSbMVNvegFt_5fgNP0WHgvo5GxwFWwQX7PhOswVZ47OcFzNd5_h9ayZRjZynMshU1xG8pJ2hVD_7RhYvNQ2JiV1HuvhYNjqAEvLRpvFV2Qfq075V3aG_0fYf04SF3dmXlAY2A6r1vlUZNFd5syRj2Q17u7Ej5tREPl3TO8M1LyqIqr3bP5g13s%3D)
---
Four months into my deployment, my life changed in ways that I couldn't have imagined. My team and I were on our way to provide support to an embattled platoon. On our way to the engagement zone, my team and ran over a roadside bomb. It all happened in an instant. The explosion soaked me in diesel and flames ignited all over my body. My gunner was able to put out the flames and save my life. If I'd been on fire for another minute I wouldn't be writing this message to you today.
---
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=851c2df024da494f81c6d68eb71bf5ee&_e=0JyR3VMSFsDMFhMW8khbunzDr1zKq617Ve8PVnCGkBBDDDLKo01mQA8ZXpD47Ajxjlp-tk8jHjMvteOFDkRCEY8rJap1twJIBilvoiYV3yyUnyDC_tpIQ7uwOehOijiaR_pbqVKOESCobLgxgxjVGz5-N4KB_hjA7K_JttH-AA42_ICiVsWO3TbK49I0KpQ-4dZLoB-05f3bt-6VQOMlOFvbkZgkn30h8jw1rQODYDB10-4JSweK_bSbMVNvegFt_5fgNP0WHgvo5GxwFWwQX31-RpdFYbUdF0R9oQFG_jan5AxzWCxz3IQcd5JPgL-41FM06eD0e0MPxvyRVYT-CyKti4ndXDSpYw_JzOdcZO3EN95RsFE7e61zgzCBD92z3QfDYRFk9_g3gBJMReDQdxReufMcsNdbNS9OA9Kc29A%3D)
---
I was rushed back to a hospital in Texas where I'd undergo countless surgeries and 3 years of rehabilitation. I'm not telling you my story because I want you to pity me or see me as a hero. Certainly, I'm not the first or last person to be injured in the line of duty. **[I want you to know my story because I hope that it'll give you confidence that I'm not a regular politician who will arrive in Washington D.C. and on day one and forget about the people I serve or those who've fought to defend our country.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=851c2df024da494f81c6d68eb71bf5ee&_e=0JyR3VMSFsDMFhMW8khbunzDr1zKq617Ve8PVnCGkBBDDDLKo01mQA8ZXpD47Ajx48Y_EZDWc33oMoKbesnX1zjYPHDNEbqwVU51npK7iViEapXTtoVhGgFggCud3fQQ7bYJZSj4QYSs226Hs7dI3d9xC64dtDeAzSMa8GswxYxfKI0fx9a7LQin4kHLSPZkxOp3utjGV1QHoWHl9Bvy2o2e0g2wb7xSiY3kJfK3aiP9dpsQ0wI3u7s9oN0EqUdH1bJrrlbgFZRPX4gC_WPF3GarWjmzpUyuXnd8IjFc6Pwnmv3GloH-VquAOgGKOo_4ITKiR2KeqzpxsG_j3R6g7gyyn2jWGaCDz3ocqmGR5DyB38MjjxLk9F315VdH0_jq4tAAQwnlmCAjyopYaCNHxPpDCqYnqazYtVJCcV38WnQ%3D)** Friend, God's plans for my life were far better than anything I could've come up with... And, in retrospect, my injuries weren't the end of my life... Rather, they were the beginning of a new one. While recovering from my injuries, I met my wife Amy, and since then we've had 3 incredible children. While working a warehouse job, I built a business that gave me the opportunity to continue to serve Americans by sprinting around the red tape and providing emergency pharmaceutical care to veterans outside of the Veterans Health Administration. _**[Friend, if you help send me to the U.S. Senate, this is the exact attitude I will bring with me.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=851c2df024da494f81c6d68eb71bf5ee&_e=0JyR3VMSFsDMFhMW8khbunzDr1zKq617Ve8PVnCGkBBDDDLKo01mQA8ZXpD47Ajxjlp-tk8jHjMvteOFDkRCEY8rJap1twJIBilvoiYV3yyUnyDC_tpIQ7uwOehOijiaR_pbqVKOESCobLgxgxjVGz5-N4KB_hjA7K_JttH-AA42_ICiVsWO3TbK49I0KpQ-4dZLoB-05f3bt-6VQOMlOFvbkZgkn30h8jw1rQODYDB10-4JSweK_bSbMVNvegFt_5fgNP0WHgvo5GxwFWwQX2JrYdz3vNv75XWB0_jHSsij-5Y713ZWTK5ckZZUgeQw7DjFhRTXIaGSTIJ9d8Nv-8ygQ8M7c9E0ZPGSUa0BZQ4PE_XOvRyFDkHX33dsRcMl-FZbSOyccAwudKs8XPF8-2Q4Ee22cVi07zYlVAJwfnA%3D)**_ I will NEVER take your support for granted - and I won't ever stop fighting to protect our country from the radical left.
---

clean_body: My name is Sam Brown, I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada. | | | Friend, I've written this letter to you and I really hope that you take a couple minutes to read it, but if you're strapped for time, here are the highlights. My name is Sam Brown, I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada. I was seriously injured while serving in Afghanistan, but in retrospect those injuries changed my life for the better and gave me the perspective I needed to become the man I am today. Today, I'm a husband, father, small businessman, and I'm the frontrunner for the Republican Senate nomination. Nevada will be the lynchpin state for both the U.S. Senate and the Presidential election in 2024. The most important fundraising deadline of the 2024 cycle is coming up. Now, here 's my story, Friend. This is a picture of me and my father. I don't remember a time when service to my family, my community, and my country wasn't central to my plans for the future. My dad was the one who raised me to give my life to God and country. In highschool, I knew that joining the military was a key part of my career path. But after the 9/11 attacks, my desire to serve my country transformed from just a career path into an ironclad resolve and passion. A few years later, I graduated from West Point and was commissioned as an infantry officer. I answered the call from my country to fight in Afghanistan. Four months into my deployment, my life changed in ways that I couldn't have imagined. My team and I were on our way to provide support to an embattled platoon. On our way to the engagement zone, my team and ran over a roadside bomb. It all happened in an instant. The explosion soaked me in diesel and flames ignited all over my body. My gunner was able to put out the flames and save my life. If I'd been on fire for another minute I wouldn't be writing this message to you today. I was rushed back to a hospital in Texas where I'd undergo countless surgeries and 3 years of rehabilitation. I'm not telling you my story because I want you to pity me or see me as a hero. Certainly, I'm not the first or last person to be injured in the line of duty. Friend, God's plans for my life were far better than anything I could've come up with... And, in retrospect, my injuries weren't the end of my life... Rather, they were the beginning of a new one. While recovering from my injuries, I met my wife Amy, and since then we've had 3 incredible children. While working a warehouse job, I built a business that gave me the opportunity to continue to serve Americans by sprinting around the red tape and providing emergency pharmaceutical care to veterans outside of the Veterans Health Administration. I will NEVER take your support for granted - and I won't ever stop fighting to protect our country from the radical left. I wish I could take on the Democrat establishment on my own, and I wish I could beat their $100 million war chest by myself. Duty First, CPT Sam Brown, U.S. Army, Ret. P.S. subject: The Mississippi Leadership Academy – why you need to sign up a young person you know
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-11571186?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,

**Woke ideology is widespread on college campuses.** Young Americans heading off to university often come back having been exposed to divisive ideas that undermine American confidence and cohesion.

**Parents and grandparents tell me they are concerned about what the next generation of Mississippians are being taught by progressive professors.**

The Mississippi Center for Public Policy has devised a program to deal with this: **The** **Mississippi Leadership Academy – the antidote to woke. [CLICK HERE FOR DETAILS](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=b7b292fe00&e=5703353baa).**
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=5eed72b147&e=5703353baa)
---
_The Mississippi Leadership Academy_
| **Our six-part program teaches young participants about the importance of liberty, limited government and American exceptionalism.** We have had world renown speakers, such as Lord Daniel Hannan, the author Matt Ridley, leading academics from Ole Miss and Mississippi College, and from the Institute of Economic Affairs, discussing:

* **The morality of the free market.**
* **Declaration of Independence & its meaning.**
* **Why do rich societies prosper?**
* **Growing Mississippi – the changes our state needs to flourish.**

Our Leadership Academy is a great opportunity to get to meet and hear from our state’s leaders, with previous contributions from:

* **Lynn Fitch, Attorney General.**
* **Shad White, State Auditor.**
* **Hon Chip Pickering.**
* **Starla Brown, AFP Mississippi. **
* **Aaron Rice, Mississippi Justice Institute.**

---
|
---
_Lynn Fitch, Attorney General at the Leadership Academy_
| **Several of last year’s graduates went on to intern in the offices of various state leaders afterwards thanks to connections they made through the program.**

Our program equips young people with the skills they need to drive change in Mississippi, with classes on:

* **Mississippi’s Legislative process – and how to influence it.**
* **Media management and training.**
* **How to defend free speech on campus.**

---
|
---
_Shad White talks to students on the program_
| **If you know someone that you believe might benefit from taking part in our Academy, please get them to sign up now! _[Here is the link:](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=c06eda8476&e=5703353baa)_**

Places are limited and our first session is in October. So, if you, or a child or grandchild might benefit from this program, **please sign them up this weekend!**

**Our Leadership Academy teaches young minds to think for themselves, and it is great training for the world that comes after college.**

I hope you will encourage a young person to sign up today!
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=d63e34d15f&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

body:
#

Peter -
Today is deadline day, and tomorrow we’ll start putting together our numbers for the report we are legally required to file with the FEC. After that, every dollar we’ve raised and every donation we’ve received will be public.
Besides the day we launched, this is the most important day of the campaign so far.
But hang on a minute. Put that aside for a second. Because right now, I want to talk to you about my decision to launch this campaign in the first place.
When I made the decision to run for Senate in Arizona, it was to take back this seat from Kyrsten Sinema. Replace her vote in the Senate with someone who actually cares about the people of our state.
That was reason enough for me.
But now, Kari Lake is getting ready to run against me. The MAGA Queen. Someone who has no problem lying, spreading misinformation — even calling for her supporters to commit violence on behalf of Donald Trump.
I lived through January 6th. I heard the shouts from the mob while I was on the House floor, barricading the doors and helping my colleagues evacuate to safety. I know what Kari Lake means for our democracy.
So today, this campaign is not just about getting another vote in the Senate. It’s not just about our priorities. It still is those things, but it’s about defending our democracy now, too.
And that is a lot of pressure. Trust me... I’m feeling it. I expect you are, too. But you are not alone in this fight. I’m with you, and thousands of others are, too.
Right now, a lot of them are making donations ahead of our deadline. They’re hoping that you will join them. Because they know that is how we will win this race.
So please, I am asking you very humbly:
[**Can you contribute $3 to our campaign before this end-of-quarter FEC deadline? That’s the only way we’ll hold the Senate. That’s the only way we’ll defend it from Kari Lake.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept23.a-3sdr&refcode=em230930-1-t1&t=1&akid=1296%2E734936%2ELMado5)

Peter, I started my campaign for U.S. Senate on one simple principle: that America needs courage, patriotism, and true conservatism back in the U.S. Senate.

We need the kind of bravery that isn’t afraid to take on either side of the aisle if it means doing what’s right.

We need real leaders who know that freedom isn’t free, and who will stand by their principles even when they’re challenged.

I’m ready to be that kind of leader in the U.S. Senate for Virginia, but before I get there, I need your help to meet the **first end-of-quarter deadline of my campaign.**

After witnessing that horrific attack on the hard-earned freedom and democracy of this country, I knew I had to put on the uniform and serve my country, so I volunteered for the Navy and was deployed to Iraq as a JAG Officer in support of SEAL Team 1.

After my time in the service, I returned to Florida, where I continued the fight to defend the values I believe in as a Congressman and now Governor of this free state. In Florida, I met my incredible wife Casey at a driving range, got married in 2009, and have since been blessed with 3 young kids: Madison (6), Mason (5), and Mamie (3). My family is the reason I will NEVER back down from my fight to get the radical Left far away from our rights as parents and the education of children. I refuse to put up with the woke mob LYING to my kids about men getting pregnant. I've watched Joe Biden try to indoctrinate children into ridiculous notions of gender ideology and radical critical race theory _**through public elementary schools.**_ As a father to my three young children, I will not accept this decline and neglect of our next generation and I will put an end to it.

#
Derek,

name: Lt. Col. Alex Vindman, USA, Ret.
subject: The last push in an incredibly busy month
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
Over the last month, even I have been surprised at what VoteVets has accomplished — with your support.
#
Derek,
When I first came on board as an advisor to VoteVets, I knew they were serious. I knew they got results. That’s part of the reason I was drawn to this organization in the first place.
But over the last month, even I have been surprised at what VoteVets has accomplished — with your support.
We put a hard-hitting advertisement up on cable news channels, including FOX News, pressuring Tommy Tuberville over his un-American hold on senior Military promotions. We drew a crowd of Senators on Capitol Hill, calling on Tuberville to end his holds. And after months of pressure, we broke him. Three members of the Joint Chiefs of Staff have been confirmed, thanks to you.
That job is not done — there are still good officers in the field, and we will not leave them behind. We won’t stop until they are confirmed.
On another front entirely, VoteVets pulled Veterans together from across the country before this government shutdown. We’re sending them to the Capitol to demand action from the GOP: get the House in order, fund the government, and get the men and women serving in our Military their paychecks.
You made that possible.
This is one of the most effective organizations in the nation. We’re incredibly grateful for your support.
And today, before our FEC deadline at midnight tonight, I need you to take one final step:
**[Chip in $5. VoteVets is legally required to file our numbers after this official FEC deadline. We’ve had an incredibly active quarter, and we’ve drawn down our resources considerably. $5 will help us rearm and put up numbers that we can all be proud of.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sept23.AXrwBB&refcode=em230930-1-15&t=1&akid=17299%2E3013755%2Epk5crZ)**

| | Friend, My name is Clara Gaitan, and I was so proud of my son Alex when he graduated from the police academy. But our dream of Alex serving as a police officer has become our family’s nightmare. **_Alex is facing 99 years in prison for catching a dangerous criminal!_** As a mother, I’m beside myself. You won’t believe how this miscarriage of justice came about. Back in March 2021, Alex was dispatched for an unknown urgent call for service. When Alex arrived at the address, he recognized he’d been there before on previous calls. The first time Alex had been there, he had to fight an inhumanly strong young man who was a drug user. Even with two other officers, it was nearly impossible to subdue the suspect. Only a non-lethal Taser worked, but not before the suspect injured an officer. However, on this day, **THREE** other officers had been dispatched to the scene, so they had a better chance of subduing the suspect. When Alex caught up with his fellow officers, he saw all three officers on the ground, struggling to bring the suspect under control. Alex told him to stop resisting, then grabbed his upper torso and put him on the ground. **Even on the ground with****FOUR AGAINST ONE****, the suspect had inhuman strength, as if he were on drugs.** Alex knew the suspect’s pain tolerance was so high that fist strikes would not work and could injure Alex. So Alex followed his training and used his police-issued baton to get the suspect to comply and lie fully on the ground. While on the ground, the suspect continued to resist the officers and their attempts to get him in handcuffs. So Alex decided to use his non-lethal Taser to get the suspect’s compliance. The Taser deployment worked, and the suspect stopped resisting the police officers. The danger was over, and Alex would come home that night. The possibility of your loved one not surviving their shift is a reality that every police family lives with, especially today when criminals are willing to fight officers. So we thought that was the end of it... **_but we were wrong._** Almost two years later, the local anti-cop, socialist District Attorney dropped a bombshell and indicted Alex for aggravated assault... ...even though it was the suspect who resisted arrest and decided it was a good idea to fight four police officers. Alex could be imprisoned for up to **99 years** if convicted. **_That’s outrageous!_** The good news is Alex has the moral support of his department, his Chief of Police, and hundreds of his Brothers and Sisters in Blue across the country. But, Friend, as you well know, cops don’t get paid a ton for the sacrifices they make and the dangers they put themselves in to keep us all safe. As a result of these attacks on my son, we’re facing a mountain of legal bills that could bury us — and send Alex to prison for up to 99 years! So when Jim Fotis and the National Center for Police Defense (NCPD), a 501(c)3 non-profit charity, offered to help us, it was like God was answering our prayers.
---
[](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8j8uOnDAQRb-m2BnZ5QfNgkUSRFajrGa2Iz-KbisYkDFJ-u8jd1C2t07VrWPTvsT5OUD3FRAfMRyACPILIJ5Fftj397f8ZD_efrHv-gPvdYjfALE8d_pPXkdaSjYuNe3GJgwKrZh9Q4MwveFdf-u65jHYnjqvpLNKCOLyFoJ1cvbKGY5a97yJA3KUvJdcSNEp3SojtdC33gltJPcaFH8VtXMmKo-4_qQcbFyerd9SswyPUvbj9dgEOB3kz0ytXSlspRKA0-r3ADgFxwoGRokpw-hPATkd25k9ffotEMgxOFZRRkkZx7jQgOYs6fMfBXJc_XJFiUI8E8jR5SvxNu023leQYwlYKzhHVr2q3wUVynVpLgGbPIT9d1yWeJgOFL-_HP2W_gYAAP__yhV_DA)

Founded by Jim Fotis, an Army veteran and retired police officer from New York, the NCPD has been instrumental in taking the lead to stand up for police officers Sheriff Joe Arpaio (“America’s Toughest Sheriff”), Tulsa’s Police Officer Betty Shelby, New York Cops Anthony Federico and Hugh Barry Jr., Michigan’s Mark Bessner, and many more. The NCPD is a 100% hard-hitting organization of police officers (retired and active) and defense attorneys who know what Alex has been through and what it takes to see his case to victory. Friend, now that you know that Alex is being railroaded for safely subduing a dangerous suspect, let me ask you point blank: **[Will you help Alex today by making a tax-deductible gift of $10, $15, $20, $25 or more to the NCPD to help them fund Alex’s defense?](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8j8uOnDAQRb-m2BnZ5QfNgkUSRFajrGa2Iz-KbisYkDFJ-u8jd1C2t07VrWPTvsT5OUD3FRAfMRyACPILIJ5Fftj397f8ZD_efrHv-gPvdYjfALE8d_pPXkdaSjYuNe3GJgwKrZh9Q4MwveFdf-u65jHYnjqvpLNKCOLyFoJ1cvbKGY5a97yJA3KUvJdcSNEp3SojtdC33gltJPcaFH8VtXMmKo-4_qQcbFyerd9SswyPUvbj9dgEOB3kz0ytXSlspRKA0-r3ADgFxwoGRokpw-hPATkd25k9ffotEMgxOFZRRkkZx7jQgOYs6fMfBXJc_XJFiUI8E8jR5SvxNu023leQYwlYKzhHVr2q3wUVynVpLgGbPIT9d1yWeJgOFL-_HP2W_gYAAP__yhV_DA) ** Alex’s legal defense will cost over $150,000, and he doesn’t have the money to pay for it. _Alex needs your help!_ Make no mistake, a shameful pattern of anti-police sentiment and cop-hating rhetoric has swept America over the past decade. Alex’s exoneration at trial is critical to restoring the integrity of policing in America. This “war on cops” is not a joke. It’s for real. And now, they’re coming after my Alex. **[Please, as the loving mother of an honorable and honest cop, I beg you to lend us a hand by donating $10, $15, $20, $25 or even $50 or $100 today.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8j8uOnDAQRb-m2BnZ5QfNgkUSRFajrGa2Iz-KbisYkDFJ-u8jd1C2t07VrWPTvsT5OUD3FRAfMRyACPILIJ5Fftj397f8ZD_efrHv-gPvdYjfALE8d_pPXkdaSjYuNe3GJgwKrZh9Q4MwveFdf-u65jHYnjqvpLNKCOLyFoJ1cvbKGY5a97yJA3KUvJdcSNEp3SojtdC33gltJPcaFH8VtXMmKo-4_qQcbFyerd9SswyPUvbj9dgEOB3kz0ytXSlspRKA0-r3ADgFxwoGRokpw-hPATkd25k9ffotEMgxOFZRRkkZx7jQgOYs6fMfBXJc_XJFiUI8E8jR5SvxNu023leQYwlYKzhHVr2q3wUVynVpLgGbPIT9d1yWeJgOFL-_HP2W_gYAAP__yhV_DA) ** From the bottom of my heart, and on behalf of my son Alex and all law enforcement personnel and their families, I thank you. Clara Gaitan P.S. Alex is the kindest, bravest, most honest police officer you could ever meet. He is the joy of our family and a highly respected member of the law enforcement community.

name: Paul Begala
subject: One of the best people and finest public servants I’ve ever known
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
Peter,
I’ve spent my career electing Democrats and winning tough elections. In 1991, my buddy James Carville and I were on the ground in Pennsylvania, helping to elect its first Democratic senator since 1969.
And in 2006, I had the pleasure of advising one of the best people — and finest public servants I’ve ever known — Bob Casey. Bob defeated Rick Santorum, and has served the people of Pennsylvania ever since.
But now, David McCormick is in the race to flip PA red. He’s a mega-millionaire hedge fund executive who could self-fund his entire campaign, and Mitch McConnell has already promised him super PAC support.
So let me tell you this right now: **[If you’re serious about defending our Senate majority in 2024, you MUST get involved in supporting Senator Bob Casey for re-election in Pennsylvania.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230930-1?refcode=em20230930-1&refcode2=801_552475_bRJIYb&akid=801%2E552475%2EbRJIYb)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230930-1?refcode=em20230930-1&refcode2=801_552475_bRJIYb&akid=801%2E552475%2EbRJIYb)**
Some folks out there think PA isn’t at serious risk of going red in 2024. But don’t just take it from me — the media has reported that Pennsylvania is one of Mitch McConnell’s top targets, and one of 10 Senate Seats most likely to flip.
It’s just a fact that national Republicans are going to do everything they can to beat Bob Casey. Not to mention, PA is key to both parties’ plans to win the presidency.
**[Please, will you join me in supporting Bob Casey with a donation today so we can keep Pennsylvania and our Senate blue?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230930-1?refcode=em20230930-1&refcode2=801_552475_bRJIYb&akid=801%2E552475%2EbRJIYb)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230930-1?refcode=em20230930-1&refcode2=801_552475_bRJIYb&akid=801%2E552475%2EbRJIYb)**
This will be one of the most competitive races in the US, and Bob needs our support. I’m counting folks like you, because I know that grassroots support will make the biggest impact on this race.
Thank you,
Paul Begala

name: Andy Kim
subject: Let me tell you about what happened a week ago:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for New Jersey
body:
Last Saturday morning – exactly one week ago – I was tired.

I was tired because I hadn't slept much. The day before, Sen. Bob Menendez was charged with accepting hundreds of thousands of dollars in bribes, including gold bars, and I didn't sleep at all that night because I was thinking about what that indictment meant.

When I first read the indictment, I thought the accusations were incredibly serious and the evidence so alarming and egregious that I just didn't see how Senator Menendez could continue to represent people in New Jersey's best interests.

Later that day, he doubled down, insisting, "I'm not going anywhere." His message was clear: Sen. Menendez is more interested in protecting himself than serving New Jersey families.

Ending government corruption has been one of the core values of my career in Congress. It's a cornerstone of this movement we've built together.

I thought about the work we've done together and what we're fighting for.

I thought about Senator Menendez's actions and how they undermine our work.

After dinner, I sat down with Kammy, and we talked about this moment. We talked about what this would mean for our family.

On Saturday morning, I called my team together and asked for their perspective. We talked about what that would mean. How this could very well be my last election ever. How, win or lose, if we decided to do this, we'd never run again for re-election in the House.

If there was ever a moment to step up and fight for our values, this was it. So Saturday afternoon, I decided that people living in New Jersey deserved a choice.

So now I'm coming to you. For the last few years, we've been fighting to build a government that answers to people.

We've been fighting for a better way to govern – one rooted in respect, integrity, and a commitment to service.

We've been fighting to restore decency in Washington.

This is our moment. We didn't ask for it. We didn't expect it. But I believe with every fiber of my being that we must seize it. Together, we can give New Jerseyans the trustworthy, hardworking representation they deserve. Together, we can bring integrity back to this Senate seat.

We can do this.

Are you with me? Donate before our deadline tonight and help power our movement forward. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim-ak4nj?refcode=2023-09-30-eoq-oneweek&recurring=&amount=9&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=01ada9fe-955f-ee11-9937-00224832eb73]

More soon,

Andy

subject: I'm writing to ask for your $3 contribution before tonight's official FEC fundraising deadline. Please give me a chance to explain why this is so important. - Ilhan
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=579%2E791427%2EXEh9fw)
Friends,
I'm writing this morning to ask you to **[make a $3 contribution before tonight's official FEC fundraising deadline.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-sept23.SIEpKD&refcode=em230930-1-t4&t=2&akid=579%2E791427%2EXEh9fw)** But before I do, please give me a chance to explain why this request is so important to our campaign.
The truth is that — second to being a mother — my job as a member of Congress, fighting for working people every day is one of the joys of my life. It's a privilege, an honor, and a blessing — one I have never taken for granted.
But if someone were to ask me what my least favorite part of this job is, I'd immediately say it's the obscene amount of money that it takes to win an election.
It's why so many of my colleagues in Congress — yes, on both sides of the aisle — are quite happy taking checks from corporate PACs, or Wall Street billionaires, or fossil fuel giants.
It's why so many people in Washington spend more time on the phone with big donors or at fancy fundraising galas than they do on the ground in their communities.
It's why our country's campaign finance laws have been gutted, and super PAC dark money runs rampant across our political system.
It's because it's easy. And things are because usually, that's just how it's done. Par for the course.
When I made my decision to run for Congress, I knew that wasn't how I was going to do things. The power of our progressive movement starts and ends with the grassroots — which means that I need to lean on you for support, especially today.
So I wish I didn't have to ask. But fighting for our movement and building the kind of campaign we need to win is something that we can only do together. Which is why I have to:
**[Can you please make a contribution — of $3 or anything you can — before tonight's FEC fundraising deadline? Your support means everything to our campaign, and every dollar makes a difference.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-sept23.SIEpKD&refcode=em230930-1-t4&t=3&akid=579%2E791427%2EXEh9fw)**

In the end, we got things done and implemented the largest infrastructure investment in our state’s history. I developed a keen nose for bullsh*t as an Army officer.
In the military when you are in uniform you always have to wear your hat (we call it a ‘cover’) when you are _outside_. I had a couple of soldiers who never seemed to be at their stations, but their covers were always there - implying they were somewhere inside the hangar and nearby.
It didn’t take long for me to check those covers out of curiosity, and wouldn’t you know they were brand-spanking-new and they were trying to pull one over on me while they walked around outside, with their first cover on and spare ones hanging inside.
So the next time they left those decoy covers at their desk, I soaked them in water and put them in the freezer for them to find. Safe to say, they stayed at their stations after that.
**Just like I could tell those soldiers were trying to see how much BS they could get away with – I can tell Brian Fitzpatrick is pulling the same bullsh*t with his fake claims of being a "moderate."**
A moderate doesn't block abortion freedom.
A moderate doesn't block our right to vote.
A moderate doesn't block gun safety.
A moderate doesn't enable extremists like Matt Gaetz and Marjorie Taylor Green.
**But freezing a few hats isn't going to get the job done this time. Nope, to teach Fitzpatrick a lesson, we have to get really tough – and kick him out of office.**

I had a couple of soldiers who never seemed to be at their stations, but their covers were always there - implying they were somewhere inside the hangar and nearby. It didn’t take long for me to check those covers out of curiosity, and wouldn’t you know they were brand-spanking-new and they were trying to pull one over on me while they walked around outside, with their first cover on and spare ones hanging inside. So the next time they left those decoy covers at their desk, I soaked them in water and put them in the freezer for them to find. Safe to say, they stayed at their stations after that. A shutdown caused by Congressional House Republicans is dangerous. It will impact the pay of as many as four million federal workers and affect everything from crucial food assistance, to transportation, Medicare and Medicaid, disaster relief, housing assistance, access to clean drinking water, and more. Far-right extremists cannot be allowed to hold the country hostage. Watch and share our latest video to help spread the word. Sincerely, Team Evergreen | | | | | | ---|---|---|---

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

If Perry’s Chaos Caucus gets their way, working families everywhere will feel the consequences. A shutdown will impact food assistance programs, federally funded preschool, federal college grants and loans, food safety inspections, National Parks, and not to mention the federal employees who will be out of work.

body:
Democrat Jacky Rosen is running for re-election and needs our help before tonight's FEC deadline.

Friends -
I'll be honest, I hadn't planned on sending another fundraising email this week, but this one is important. It's about a critical — and often overlooked — U.S. Senate race in Nevada.
Democrat Jacky Rosen is running for re-election and needs our help before tonight's FEC deadline.
The polls have this race VERY close. CNN says it's one of the seats most likely to flip in 2024. And Time Magazine says the outcome in Nevada can "deliver the Senate, and maybe even the White House to Republicans in 2024."
All of us have a role to play in making sure that doesn’t happen.
As you read this, Republicans are in a bitter primary featuring a far-right election denier running against another far-right Republican.
That gives Jacky Rosen a very important opportunity to define herself to Nevada voters while Republicans attack each other (and before they spend to define her).

Hey friend — it’s David Hogg, gun safety advocate and co-founder of March For Our Lives.
The GOP and conservative special interest groups have been playing a 50-year chess game to elect far-right extremists to every level of government to manipulate our country and attack our rights and freedoms. They are willing to let children be slaughtered at school and watch our planet burn for personal gain.
But badass young people have a habit of being underestimated, from March For Our Lives to the Sunrise Movement to the Movement for Black Lives. And when we demonstrate our collective power, we scare the shit out of Republicans.
That’s why with an incredible team, we launched Leaders We Deserve — a grassroots organization dedicated to electing young leaders to Congress, and especially our State Legislatures, across the country to help defeat the far-right’s agenda and advance a progressive vision for the future.
We can’t do this without you by our side. Will you become a Founding Donor by splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
I’ll be blunt: There is no shortage of people who want us to fail. And unless we band together and fight back, nothing is going to change.
It’s part of why despite making up 45% of the electorate, Gen Z and Millennials only hold 21% of State Legislature seats.
Special interest groups, far-right extremists, and those hoarding the power are so determined to maintain the status quo that they will spend millions to keep Gen Z candidates from winning. They think that they can continue to manipulate the system to keep us out of elected office.
Let’s prove them wrong, friend.
That’s why I’m personally asking: Will you become a Founding Donor to Leaders We Deserve by splitting a donation with Serve America today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Let’s do this,
David Hogg Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

A few years ago, I wouldn’t have guessed I’d be in your inbox asking for support ahead of an “end-of-quarter deadline.”
But these emails do something pretty powerful, Derek, they allow people like me–a single mom of three who had no experience in politics prior to running in 2018–to compete against politicians who have spent decades climbing the ladders of Washington, collecting corporate checks. **_[So here I am, humbly asking via email for you to chip in $3, $7, or $20 before our federal end-of-quarter fundraising deadline tonight.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230930-1?refcode=EMAL30_1_EML_20230930_V1_F&refcode2=30679_3422442_DalMQ5&akid=30679%2E3422442%2EDalMQ5)**_
Derek, Congress wasn't built for people like me. When I first got to Washington, I was the only single mom of school-age kids serving. There were groups like the Bourbon Caucus and the Beer Caucus—but not a caucus focused on the cost of higher education.
And while at times that is frustrating, I didn’t come to Washington to play by the rules! **I came to Washington to shake things up, and that’s what I’ve been able to do thanks to the support of Porter Supporters like you.** With my whiteboard in tow, we’ve not only called out skyrocketing CEO pay and brought life to Congressional Hearings, but passed real legislation to lower drug costs, raise rates on polluters, and strengthen our economy.
Now, I’m running to take our fight to the U.S. Senate. Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them, not just their biggest donors—and I’m proud to be the only candidate in this race who is rejecting both corporate PAC and federal lobbyist money. **But I won’t sugarcoat it—our campaign has been outraised every quarter so far.**
