Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

You’re receiving this message because of your past support of Democratic candidates and causes. Roland Gutierrez is running to defeat Ted Cruz for Senate. We need your support to elect Roland, but if you’d prefer not to receive emails from our campaign, you can unsubscribe: https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/ifYYiIyK0UCnX-4gLHfqiQ2?unsubscribedata=WmDWn5aC%2BeNhijR%2FfzO2phn15TmYM5qW8Y12uolBwUQrg81KA3FPLPCmWtP5UEbZdasRH8ftguI%2BeKV79yFAxHyCvtHpgkhFqV4rhJNPY7bKFv3%2BsCdwTZFTLs53A%2BWPMv8GlBu9WzcWvXs4GmNch8kqQZfJ011%2FYosVmDLjrvj8IlvG0kzCxCYoCqZzUZm8WYcUO6xvAfgTZd7Mly%2BS3WuE9H7XJd0BOxtuGchbeiLEwSsEqnuzwnl0SANvvCW1gdd1dHKYDRLkRjDRgtank8dvGiJ1s17i2GwRgU0dm%2FH8WNZgXKOzWaqD2keQ%2FMSNj2VC%2Bi%2FMTh9cxR5ZWsZ9YrTXle1%2FNFqB5PmsC98Srlm8dQQTYE76yCyhtZ%2BtbGokVFjsCSLZ5ZJtw96zdyOC5RtNSfdh2l11aEGUSwrqQOcbFLyqID%2B%2BkmBhupXnzE3l .

Peter,
The first end-of-quarter deadline of my campaign is in less than 24 hours. We’re statistically tied with Rick Scott in a new poll, so we need to show strong fundraising numbers here to make sure he can’t pull ahead of us. But right now, we’re $32,119 short of my $350,000 goal.
That’s why I’m about to ask you to make a $15 donation to my campaign. But first, will you let me explain why I’m in this race? (If you’re ready to donate now, you can click here to split an end-of-quarter gift between Roland Gutierrez and my campaign.) [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/rg2024-em-dmp]
I came to this country as a 14-year-old immigrant from Ecuador. My family lived in a one room apartment, and my mom worked double shifts to pay the bills. I got a job at the local doughnut shop to help her make ends meet.
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/rg2024-em-dmp [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/rg2024-em-dmp]
I’ve seen firsthand just how difficult it is for working families to get by. But I’ve also seen the incredible opportunities that are only possible in America.
I was able to attend college, give back to my community, and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. And, after years of long shifts and late night classes to learn English, my mom was able to retire with dignity thanks to Social Security and Medicare.
Make no mistake: There’s a lot of work that we have to do to make sure that every family has the chance to achieve their American Dream. That’s why I’m running for Senate — to protect and expand the opportunities that made my story possible.
I’m running against Rick Scott, who’s spent his career attacking those opportunities and threatening vital programs like Social Security and Medicare. He has a personal fortune of up to a quarter of a billion dollars to fund his campaign. That’s why I’m counting on a grassroots army made up of people like you to fight back.
Please, will you split $15 between Roland Gutierrez and my campaign before midnight tonight to help me hit my end-of-quarter goal and protect the opportunities that make the American Dream possible? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/rg2024-em-dmp]
Thank you,
Debbie

Make no mistake: There’s a lot of work that we have to do to make sure that every family has the chance to achieve their American Dream. That’s why I’m running for Senate — to protect and expand the opportunities that made my story possible. I’m running against Rick Scott, who’s spent his career attacking those opportunities and threatening vital programs like Social Security and Medicare. He has a personal fortune of up to a quarter of a billion dollars to fund his campaign. That’s why I’m counting on a grassroots army made up of people like you to fight back. We can’t continue the piecemeal, inadequate status quo of government services. Our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Most families are living paycheck to paycheck.
But **the majority of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires**. They don’t understand what it feels like not being able to pay rent or make ends meet.
**I grew up in a working-class UAW household** , and my lived experience teaches me to lead with compassion. I understand how urgently we need bold federal action for economic justice.
I led the fight for the temporarily expanded Child Tax Credit, which lifted millions of children out of poverty in 2021 and cut child poverty in nearly half. But corporate Democrats and Republicans let it expire. So**I introduced legislation to cut childhood poverty by 70%** —by providing families with a universal benefit of nearly $400 per month per child.
I’m also fighting alongside restaurant workers to end the shameful federal tipped minimum wage of just $2.13 an hour—a starvation wage. I reintroduced the Restaurant Workers Bill of Rights to**ensure thriving wages, require paid leave and healthcare coverage, protect workers’ ability to unionize without fear of retaliation** , and more.
Last year, I led the fight in Congress to support rail workers preparing for a historic strike. And I ended up being one of the few Democrats who voted against forcing an unfair contract on them. Congress and the President squashed rail workers’ right to strike. We cannot undermine worker power again.
I’m calling on Democrats to truly be the party of the working class, and to **defend the right to strike—which is a powerful tool to fight corporate greed.**

clean_body: Major victories in our movement to end poverty: | | | Friend, You’re an essential part of our movement to end poverty, and we won major victories recently that wouldn’t be possible without you. We led the call in Congress to remove medical debt from credit reports when we introduced the Restoring Unfairly Impaired Credit & Protecting Consumers Act. Now the Biden administration has announced executive action to do just that. This important step will belife-changing for millions of people whose credit scores impact access to housing and employment. I’m also honored to join striking UAW workers in my district who are making history fighting corporate greed. I’ve joined workers on the picket line and together we’ve sent hundreds of thousands of messages to the CEOs of the Big Three urging them to immediately meet workers’ demands. Now, this week, President Biden came to Michigan to join striking workers on the picket line—marking the first time a sitting president has done so. We’re leading the nation and building the power we need to enact sweeping, life-changing policies like universal paid sick leave and healthcare as a human right. None of this would be possible without your support. Today represents a critical fundraising deadline for our campaign and our movement for change. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | We can’t continue the piecemeal, inadequate status quo of government services. Our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Most families are living paycheck to paycheck. But the majority of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires. They don’t understand what it feels like not being able to pay rent or make ends meet. I grew up in a working-class UAW household , and my lived experience teaches me to lead with compassion. I understand how urgently we need bold federal action for economic justice. I led the fight for the temporarily expanded Child Tax Credit, which lifted millions of children out of poverty in 2021 and cut child poverty in nearly half. But corporate Democrats and Republicans let it expire. SoI introduced legislation to cut childhood poverty by 70% —by providing families with a universal benefit of nearly $400 per month per child. I’m also fighting alongside restaurant workers to end the shameful federal tipped minimum wage of just $2.13 an hour—a starvation wage. I reintroduced the Restaurant Workers Bill of Rights toensure thriving wages, require paid leave and healthcare coverage, protect workers’ ability to unionize without fear of retaliation , and more. Last year, I led the fight in Congress to support rail workers preparing for a historic strike. And I ended up being one of the few Democrats who voted against forcing an unfair contract on them. Congress and the President squashed rail workers’ right to strike. We cannot undermine worker power again. I’m calling on Democrats to truly be the party of the working class, and to defend the right to strike—which is a powerful tool to fight corporate greed. Our federal government is supposed to protect everyday people from corporate greed and exploitation. That’s the government I’m building, with your support. body:
Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
It’s hard to believe that it’s already been around a month since I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate here in Florida. It’s been a whirlwind of meeting voters, hearing from supporters like you, and spreading our message of progress and unity.
Now, we’re rapidly approaching our first end-of-quarter deadline. This is the biggest moment of our campaign yet. Our fundraising numbers are about to become public for the first time — and all eyes will be on us.
This is our chance to prove the strength of our movement to Rick Scott, the pundits, the GOP’s megadonors, and the people of Florida. That’s why I’ve set an ambitious $350,000 goal — and I’m counting on your help to hit it. Please, will you split a donation between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign before midnight tonight to help us hit our end-of-quarter goal so that we can pull ahead in the polls? [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]

Thanks to grassroots Democrats like you, we have the momentum advantage — a new poll shows that this race is already tied!
As I look back on these past few weeks, I’m filled with so much gratitude for supporters like you. But I also have to be realistic about what we’re up against here.
Rick Scott and his far-right megadonors are prepared to launch even more attacks against our campaign. And if they see any sign of weakness in our public fundraising numbers, they won’t hesitate to destroy our momentum.
I’m in this race to fight for the issues that matter to families like yours — protecting Social Security and Medicare, ending gun violence, restoring reproductive rights, strengthening voting rights, and more. I promise you that I will always have your back in Washington. But today, I need you to have mine.
Please, will you split $5 between Kirsten Gillibrand and me to flip Florida blue and defend our Senate majority? I can only defeat Rick Scott and his personal fortune if people like you stand with me. [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for all that you’ve done to get our campaign started on the strongest foot possible.
With immense gratitude,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

Hi there, it’s Gabby Giffords.
While I was enjoying my coffee this morning, I found my thoughts drifting to all of you and the movement that we’ve built together to fight for a future free from gun violence. I feel so much hope when I think about the progress we have made over the past ten years, and I hope you do too.

In the past ten years, GIFFORDS has helped pass over 525 gun safety laws at the state level. Last year, we passed the most significant federal gun safety legislation in nearly three decades. Right now, we’re closer to enacting universal background checks than we’ve ever been before. This is real progress, but there’s still so much more work to do.
As I always say, we must keep moving ahead.
That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. Our September quarterly fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight. We need all hands on deck to show our gun lobby adversaries that our fundraising numbers match the strength of our grassroots movement.

| [](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/it3yAJ8PrIidXpOUHhAAZQ~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRm-sO_P0TBaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMDkzMF9lbV9mcl9iMV9kYXZpZGhvZ2dfZW4mY2RtYz0yVzdiMEw0dXRBNUI4TGk0d1QyelRaOFh4VGYmcmVmY29kZTI9Mlc3YjBMNHV0QTVCOExpNHdUMnpUWjhYeFRmJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJXN2IwTDR1dEE1QjhMaTR3VDJ6VFo4WHhUZlcDc3BjQgplFL8-GGVYzC91UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAaQ~~) I’m (almost) at a loss for words sharing this announcement with you, Peter:

**President Joe Biden just announced the creation of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention.**

This win couldn’t have happened without the non-stop work of young leaders and activists across the country, especially my friend Maxwell Frost. After four long years of protests, registering thousands of young voters, meeting after meeting, and MANY Zoom calls...we did it!!!

I’ll share more about the work young leaders, including Maxwell and I, did to get us to this point, but first: [**_Please make a donation to Maxwell’s campaign to help carry this momentum forward._**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/98q28KwdcZ0W7ZoDu7gp5w~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRm-sO_P0TLaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMDkzMF9lbV9mcl9iMV9kYXZpZGhvZ2dfZW4mYW1vdW50PTI3JmNkbWM9Mlc3YjBMNHV0QTVCOExpNHdUMnpUWjhYeFRmJnJlZmNvZGUyPTJXN2IwTDR1dEE1QjhMaTR3VDJ6VFo4WHhUZiZyZWZjb2RlY2RtYz0yVzdiMEw0dXRBNUI4TGk0d1QyelRaOFh4VGZXA3NwY0IKZRS_PhhlWMwvdVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAGk~)

**Here’s why we can draw a direct line from our work to the Biden administration’s new Office of Gun Violence Prevention, Peter.**

**When we talk about electing the “leaders we deserve,” we’re talking about folks like Maxwell Frost,** one of our Advisory Board members for Leaders We Deserve and, as I’m sure you know, the first Gen-Z Member of Congress.

Maxwell served as the first National Organizing Director for March For Our Lives and really helped us level-up our organizing work, especially on behalf of a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. We did everything from asking presidential candidates about opening that department if they were elected at our 2020 Gun Safety Forum to sleeping on an office floor in the Virginia House of Delegates to ensure we were able to lobby on behalf of gun violence prevention.

We continued this work for four years, and it didn’t stop when Maxwell got elected.

The very first bill he introduced on the House floor was to establish a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention. Republicans blocked it, but he didn’t give up, and neither did we. Even when it became clear that NRA-sponsored politicians weren’t going to let his bill pass, President Biden stepped in. In fact, Vice President Kamala Harris introduced Maxwell at the official announcement of the Office of GVP, and Maxwell got to introduce President Biden!!

**When we talk about leveraging the power of the youth vote, we’re talking about years of record-breaking youth voting turnout that led us to this recent announcement.** In the last five years, we went from having the most pro-NRA president in American history to the most pro-gun safety president in American history. Young people were critical in electing Biden.

Our voices and votes matter.

[**_Help us carry this momentum and get more life-saving sh*t done by making a donation to Maxwell’s campaign today._**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/98q28KwdcZ0W7ZoDu7gp5w~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRm-sO_P0TLaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMDkzMF9lbV9mcl9iMV9kYXZpZGhvZ2dfZW4mYW1vdW50PTI3JmNkbWM9Mlc3YjBMNHV0QTVCOExpNHdUMnpUWjhYeFRmJnJlZmNvZGUyPTJXN2IwTDR1dEE1QjhMaTR3VDJ6VFo4WHhUZiZyZWZjb2RlY2RtYz0yVzdiMEw0dXRBNUI4TGk0d1QyelRaOFh4VGZXA3NwY0IKZRS_PhhlWMwvdVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAGk~)

We should celebrate this momentous victory, Peter — but it doesn’t mean we can slow down or stop anytime soon.

There is still so much work to be done, from tackling the climate crisis to expanding abortion access to building a country that isn’t run by the rich and powerful few.

There is a long road ahead of us, and we need your help if we’re going to score more wins, elect more young people to office, and stop the fascist takeover of our country.

name: Victoria
subject: About my mom, Allyson
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Allyson for Congress
body:
Hi. I’m Victoria, a 17 year old from Tustin California and my mom is running for congress in California 40 (yes, I am actually the one writing this email, all words courtesy of me).

As I head toward going to college, I want to have the same rights as women in the 1970s, and, due to my metabolic condition, a pregnancy would be extremely dangerous. However, I am no longer sure that if I were to be put in that situation, I would have a continued chance at living. Not because of my condition, but because of the laws that prevent me getting access to the care I need.

I am well aware that in California abortion is still legal, but with a federal ban on the horizon, my mom needs to win. And, she also needs to have the money to do it. This is why I am writing to you today. I encourage you to give whatever you can to help her take on her competition, so that me and all my friends and the women behind me can have a future that continues to move forward into tomorrow.

Hey Peter, Tara here — today is the last day of the month, so I’ll cut to the chase:

body:
Hi Peter, Josh Shapiro here.
There’s one thing I know for sure about the election ahead: extremist Republicans are committed to doing in 2024 what they tried to do in 2022 — **flip Pennsylvania.**

We’re not stopping until any and every voter is educated on what’s at stake in November. We’re leaving no stone unturned. A strong showing this month will ensure we have the support we need to prepare every Ohio voter – from Dayton to Cleveland – on how to register to vote, where their polling place is, and remind them that the entire fight for abortion rights in this country is centered around Ohio right now. = Thank you, Ohio Democrats | A reproductive rights initiative is on the Ohio ballot this November. Can Ohio Democrats count on you to chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can to help fuel our fight to protect reproductive rights in our state constitution? → | = | 697 East Broad Street Suite 101 Columbus, Ohio 43215 | Paid for by the Ohio Democratic Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. | Click here to from the Ohio Democratic Party's email list.

Join our fight for everyday, hard working Americans
Friend,
There's no reason to panic. Sometimes, "urgent" fundraising requests hit people's inboxes at the end of the quarter, and I won't falsely alarm you. The sky isn't falling.
Political campaigns use some "interesting" tactics to raise funds at the end of the quarter: "If we don't hit our goal, we're going to lose!" That is not the case. Politics needs honesty. I know it is rare.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Construction.png]
We're close to our goal, but still have much work to do. If you're familiar with how these deadlines work and want to rush a contribution, please do [actblue.com/donate/about-bob] , or read on and let me explain...
RUSH A CONTRIBUTION [actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
actblue.com/donate/about-bob [actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend,
With or without the Sept. 30 fundraising deadline established by the FEC, we set an internal goal to hit 2,500 unique donors before the end of quarter. It's a figure based on how much momentum we need to pay my staff, our bills, and save for a field program in the Spring.
As of now, we have reached 76% of our Q3 goal. However, we still need to acquire over 500 additional donors before midnight. [http://actblue.com/donate/about-bob] Transparently, I would be pleasantly surprised if we hit that. Our campaign is expected to remain strong for the rest of the year regardless.
Notice how I didn't mention a dollar figure. "We need to raise $10,000 before Friday!" Nope. Look, I fundamentally believe in campaign finance reform. I want to focus on issues, solving problems, listening to and connecting with as many voters as possible, rather than chasing money.
That's exactly where money and politics don't mix. No one will buy this election, but we need to show force to stay competitive.
And I aim to show a people-power force . I want as many donors as possible - whether you give $2, $10, $20 or more [http://actblue.com/donate/about-bob] , our quarterly report should reflect the people for whom I am fighting - a lot of real, everyday, hardworking Americans.
I reject corporate PACS. I refuse dark money. I have no ultra-wealthy mega-donors. This is pure grassroots, pure people power, and it requires you in my corner. Today, I need your help getting as close to our goal as possible.
Friend, I want your name as a contributor [actblue.com/donate/about-bob] on my quarterly report. I would be very grateful.
Every day, I try to discuss real issues facing Americans - healthcare, Social Security, infrastructure, childcare, housing, public education, the dangers of a looming shut down and more. Please stand with me [http://actblue.com/donate/about-bob] to do that the most effective way I know how - advocating and fighting for everyday people as a future Congressman. Friend, will you please chip in today?
I appreciate your consideration. If you have any questions and want to chat personally with me before contributing, let's schedule a call at votedrbob.com/cc . [votedrbob.com/cc]
V/R,
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan and the UP
Democrat, MI01

September 30, 2023
Dear Friend,
Today is the last day of our fundraising quarter. Today is the last chance to
help Tennessee Voter Project (TVP) for this quarter, the last reporting quarter before the critical City of Memphis elections.
We are working hard right now to support our candidates in the City of
Memphis races, including our candidates for Memphis City Council, Jerri Green (District 2), Meggan Kiel (District 5), and Michalyn Easter-Thomas (District 7).
We are also making our final push to get the word out about our endorsed
candidate for Memphis Mayor, Attorney Van Turner.
Van Turner has been at the work of supporting working families for years.
He was Chair of the Shelby County Democratic Party. He was President of the Memphis branch of the NAACP, one of the most active branches in the nation. He helped lead the movement to remove confederate monuments from Memphis’ parks.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. body:
I’m fighting for permanent protections so that I can start pursuing my dreams of starting a business, buying a home, and even voting for the people who represent me. | | | Hi Peter, I’m Jazmin. I’m a junior at Colorado State University. Like all of my peers, I’m interested in summer jobs, internships, and study abroad programs in the field I’m studying. But there’s one difference between us: **I can’t apply to any of them — all because of my status.** I came to the US with my family when I was 4 years old. I’m undocumented, which means I can’t legally work here or re-enter the country if I travel abroad. I’m eligible for DACA — but because of Judge Hanen’s decision to close DACA to new applicants, I’m shut out of the program. That means no work permit or protection from deportation. And just recently, Judge Hanen doubled down on his decision against new DACA applications, leaving millions of immigrant youth like me in limbo without protections. **That’s why UWDA is leading the charge to secure permanent protections from Congress and the White House. As a part of a mixed-status family, I see the differences that come with immigration status in my own home.
My 15-year-old younger brother was born here and is a U.S. citizen. He’ll be able to get a part-time job to earn spending money and travel to foreign countries that I could only dream of. He’ll be able to get an internship to gain practical experience in his field.
He also won’t have to worry about breaking minor laws. My worst fear is landing in detention for something as simple as jaywalking. _I can’t imagine what that would do to my parents._
I also can’t really imagine a future in which I graduate with this amazing degree and am unable to do the work I’ve been trained to do. Someday, I even want to start my own business.
**But until we win permanent protections, my life and the lives of millions more will be put on pause — at the mercy of court case after court case.**
I’m fighting for permanent protections so that I can start pursuing my dreams of starting a business, buying a home, and even voting for the people who represent me.
Congress has an opportunity to deliver, and with the future of DACA up in the air, it’s urgent that they act now.
**Peter, add a donation to help UWDA fight for permanent protections before it’s too late.**

clean_body: I’m fighting for permanent protections so that I can start pursuing my dreams of starting a business, buying a home, and even voting for the people who represent me. | | | Hi Peter, I’m Jazmin. I’m a junior at Colorado State University. Like all of my peers, I’m interested in summer jobs, internships, and study abroad programs in the field I’m studying. But there’s one difference between us: I can’t apply to any of them — all because of my status. I came to the US with my family when I was 4 years old. I’m undocumented, which means I can’t legally work here or re-enter the country if I travel abroad. I’m eligible for DACA — but because of Judge Hanen’s decision to close DACA to new applicants, I’m shut out of the program. That means no work permit or protection from deportation. And just recently, Judge Hanen doubled down on his decision against new DACA applications, leaving millions of immigrant youth like me in limbo without protections. That’s why UWDA is leading the charge to secure permanent protections from Congress and the White House. Will you chip in to help us scale up our advocacy work and secure a pathway to citizenship for immigrant youth and all undocumented people? If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | As a part of a mixed-status family, I see the differences that come with immigration status in my own home. My 15-year-old younger brother was born here and is a U.S. citizen. He’ll be able to get a part-time job to earn spending money and travel to foreign countries that I could only dream of. He’ll be able to get an internship to gain practical experience in his field. He also won’t have to worry about breaking minor laws. My worst fear is landing in detention for something as simple as jaywalking. I can’t imagine what that would do to my parents. I also can’t really imagine a future in which I graduate with this amazing degree and am unable to do the work I’ve been trained to do. Someday, I even want to start my own business. But until we win permanent protections, my life and the lives of millions more will be put on pause — at the mercy of court case after court case. I’m fighting for permanent protections so that I can start pursuing my dreams of starting a business, buying a home, and even voting for the people who represent me. Congress has an opportunity to deliver, and with the future of DACA up in the air, it’s urgent that they act now. Peter, add a donation to help UWDA fight for permanent protections before it’s too late. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | ** Thank you for letting me share my story, Jazmin, United We Dream Action

A lengthy and detailed indictment lays out charges of bribery and of corrupt foreign dealings against the Senator from New Jersey. Senator Menendez is entitled to the presumption of innocence under our system, but he is not entitled to continue to wield influence over national policy, especially given the serious and specific nature of the allegations. **He should choose an honorable exit and resign.** As of right now, it seems as if my colleague is refusing to step down and is continuing to campaign for re-election. clean_body: We’re powerful when we join together in solidarity. | | Peter, I just joined Cori Bush in Wentzville, Missouri to support and talk with striking workers from UAW Local 2250. When workers demand better, they’re speaking up on behalf of workers everywhere. And thanks to the resurgence of worker organizing, this week President Biden joined UAW strikers in solidarity -- becoming the first President in modern American history to join a union picket line. We also won a victory in the movement for high-quality, good-paying green jobs last week, as the Biden administration launched the American Climate Corps. The program will create clean energy and climate resilience jobs for more than 20,000 young people in its first year. This is an important moment in the movement for economic justice, climate justice, and worker power. Cori Bush and I have been low-wage workers, and our experiences fuel us to push for bold federal action. We’re leading policy solutions that are big enough to match the crises that everyday people are facing. ** In a pattern that’s playing out across industries, the “Big Three” auto companies have jacked up CEO pay to ludicrous levels and wasted hundreds of millions of dollars on stock buybacks to manipulate prices -- all while starving the workers who actually make their products. We must have workers’ backs, especially in this time of rising inequality and corporate influence in politics. I’m proud to join Cori in supporting all workers in demanding better pay and better working conditions. And thanks to the recent launch of the American Climate Corps, we’re now closer to a Green New Deal that would create millions of high-wage union jobs. We are so much more powerful when we join together in solidarity. And there’s so much more work to do to ensure economic justice for all. name: Sherrod Brown
subject: a personal ask from me to you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230930-2?refcode=em20230930-2-8601&refcode2=8601_434096_kns3TG&akid=8601%2E434096%2Ekns3TG)
Hi Derek, it’s Sen. Sherrod Brown from Ohio. I’ve spent my life fighting for the Dignity of Work -- and I mean _all_ work. Whether you punch a time clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I’ll fight for you.
I’m running for reelection so I can _keep_ fighting for workers and families in the Senate -- but I need your help. As the only remaining statewide Democrat in Ohio, analysts at _CNN_ say I’m one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot -- and national Republicans are already launching attack ads against me.
**The battle for Senate control could all come down to Ohio -- so please, I’m personally asking: [Will you give $5 or more right now -- split between my campaign and John Fetterman’s -- to help defend this battleground seat and keep the Senate blue? ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230930-2?refcode=em20230930-2-8601&refcode2=8601_434096_kns3TG&akid=8601%2E434096%2Ekns3TG)**
I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers and electricians. And I’ll be honest with you: The Ohio I live in now looks a lot different than the one I grew up in. I’m fighting in the Senate every day to bring those jobs back, to build our economy by investing in the middle class, and to ensure hard work pays off for every American.
But I’m facing my toughest race yet -- in a state Donald Trump won by 8 points. Last year’s Ohio Senate race was one of the most costly and competitive in the nation, and _NBC News_ reports that this one could be “even nastier and more expensive.”
**The long and short of it is, I can’t win -- and Democrats simply can’t hold onto our narrow Senate majority -- if we don’t have strong grassroots support from folks like you.**
**[That’s why I’m asking for your support today, Derek: Please, will you chip in $5 or more now-- split between my campaign and John Fetterman’s -- so we can win in Ohio and defend the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230930-2?refcode=em20230930-2-8601&refcode2=8601_434096_kns3TG&akid=8601%2E434096%2Ekns3TG)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230930-2?amount=5&refcode=em20230930-8601&refcode2=8601_434096_kns3TG&akid=8601%2E434096%2Ekns3TG)**
With gratitude,
Sherrod Brown

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20230930-8601-footer&t=1&refcode2=8601_434096_kns3TG&akid=8601%2E434096%2Ekns3TG)**

subject: I can’t do this alone
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| When I first ran for Senate in 2012, a lot of powerful people didn’t think I had a shot
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=1262%2E35263%2Ernzd66)
This is it, Peter — our public fundraising deadline is at midnight tonight, so I’m reaching out one more time to ask for your support. But before I do that, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on how we got here. **[If you are ready to make a donation now to defend our Senate majority and keep Wisconsin blue, you can click here to do so.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep23.1u6uGA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20230930_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=1262%2E35263%2Ernzd66)** When I first ran for Senate in 2012, a lot of powerful people didn’t think I had a shot. They thought there was no way Wisconsin would send an openly gay woman to the U.S. Senate. That didn’t matter to me though, because I only had one goal: **to fight as hard as I could to make a real difference in people’s lives.** I also knew that I had an incredible grassroots team behind me, and I had faith we could accomplish anything together. Thanks to this team, I became the first woman elected to the United States Senate from Wisconsin and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. And I’ve been fighting every day since to protect and expand LGBTQ+ rights, defend our democracy, make health care accessible and affordable, and so much more. But there are threats on the horizon putting all the progress we’ve made in jeopardy. As you probably already know, Republicans only need to flip two seats to take the Senate majority, and our race is one of their top targets. Wisconsin is known for its competitive elections, and the GOP is willing to spend _tens of millions_ to defeat me. There are multiple right-wing megamillionaires preparing to jump into this race. That’s why tonight’s deadline is so important. We need our public fundraising report to leave no doubt that our grassroots team has what it takes to defend this Wisconsin U.S. Senate seat and our Democratic majority. **Every single contribution on our report will make a huge statement about the strength of our campaign — so I’m personally asking, Peter:** **[Can I count on you to make a $5 contribution before our public fundraising deadline at midnight tonight? Defending this seat and our Democratic Senate majority will take all of us — I can’t do this alone.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-sep23.1u6uGA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20230930_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=1262%2E35263%2Ernzd66)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $5 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2150?c0=tbe-em-sep23.g8eV4w&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20230930_AM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=1262%2E35263%2Ernzd66)

Friend,
Here’s the deal. I’m running for Senate because the status quo is not working, and my opponents have 50 years combined in Congress representing the status quo. I’m bringing new ideas, fresh perspectives, and a track record of getting things done.
As a nonprofit and business leader, I was able to secure $2.5B in funding for small businesses during the pandemic.
As a champion for the underserved I started the first advocacy lending program to fund women and BIPOC business leaders at American Express.
Yet with a combined 50 years of experience in career politics, what do my opponents have to show for it?

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=a13c0a014ad74861ab31af444456d86f&_e=ZxD2c1nvxN6qUHpnF7ev6oXhi781QBwT9xW5i-40IVz94a27KX3oJh6OI8m3j8PXX9Ydr_tj5kt9n2OU9_bNaMcUMGmtvWoBUM8czCj9WFgub3TwQk8zMWZf4dkbFZZ_OkaiFA3J8kCYCt4BuCXrXWIAQOhPp_aoMcyKKcPI96Y-DcF29mOqntiYcFVoTts606vRBPUqCdljsgi9PIcTCdei4aP50aN4gqUG3rid2z0cJU_XL3QrwnmKviYhmGvePK1R4ucTmV_18bvDjkcqeg33H5RBxRHwo3lbYR2_PxvBx79xgKmFS8YWDaiO91xHRzRf8smIF6lAHo72byrI21s4i9dGTRpscEfMk_bb15E_xXOiRShcCMJUv2O92H9t5fuLaM_HffkVlaHDDHtz1GfUCEVKSe1kwLF2bxEQr99Ge-hmIychjItfBjfJLKbe9_vNh7YMtMXpfdsB4yd_zUrrpoV7Cs7fG6bAdtpFTKM8AAcLwXRVmitJeU4CAPE640jMEJjYq3IypIQ0rTo_fuAuXwdT_PlOmFyxluslkh5exsucOKaWYHA5Wadq65fKq6eN8DPDwwX3umDXHF91FPNNX47lxF_rjsNFcWZVi68%3D "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=a13c0a014ad74861ab31af444456d86f&_e=ZxD2c1nvxN6qUHpnF7ev6oXhi781QBwT9xW5i-40IVz94a27KX3oJh6OI8m3j8PXX9Ydr_tj5kt9n2OU9_bNaMcUMGmtvWoBUM8czCj9WFgub3TwQk8zMWZf4dkbFZZ_OkaiFA3J8kCYCt4BuCXrXWIAQOhPp_aoMcyKKcPI96Y-DcF29mOqntiYcFVoTts606vRBPUqCdljsgi9PIcTCdei4aP50aN4gqUG3rid2z0cJU_XL3QrwnmKviYhmGvePK1R4ucTmV_18bvDjkcqeg33H5RBxRHwo3lbYR2_PxvBx79xgKmFS8YWDaiO91xHRzRf8smIF6lAHo72byrI21s4i9dGTRpscEfMk_bb15E_xXOiRShcCMJUv2O92H9t5fuLaM_HffkVlaHDDHtz1GfUCEVKSe1kwLF2bxEQr99Ge-hmIychjItfBjfJLKbe9_vNh7YMtMXpfdsB4yd_za8urDULH2-McUejBZbFcGoXkpry3LtkM1HASEUBUflYRbraet0ZfXPVfht-pPu9zlHpgJP0NqNmJgOHMA9bDF7L6T0QT2v1wDNAMiWGEv0I09Mi-6iRHQ9kYLt_EUMMuTWluTh5eIO0ifG6ui3LjZY%3D)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=a13c0a014ad74861ab31af444456d86f&_e=ZxD2c1nvxN6qUHpnF7ev6oXhi781QBwT9xW5i-40IVz94a27KX3oJh6OI8m3j8PXX9Ydr_tj5kt9n2OU9_bNaMcUMGmtvWoBUM8czCj9WFgub3TwQk8zMWZf4dkbFZZ_OkaiFA3J8kCYCt4BuCXrXWIAQOhPp_aoMcyKKcPI96Y-DcF29mOqntiYcFVoTts606vRBPUqCdljsgi9PIcTCdei4aP50aN4gqUG3rid2z0cJU_XL3QrwnmKviYhmGvePK1R4ucTmV_18bvDjkcqeg33H5RBxRHwo3lbYR2_PxvBx79xgKmFS8YWDaiO91xHRzRf8smIF6lAHo72byrI21s4i9dGTRpscEfMk_bb15E_xXOiRShcCMJUv2O92H9t5fuLaM_HffkVlaHDDHtz1GfUCEVKSe1kwLF2bxEQr99Ge-hmIychjItfBjfJLKbe9_vNh7YMtMXpfdsB4yd_zSNjIQaS-O340ZUGYOwcnr-sidN50eHM6mISouAWCz66nVopeU23E9PISuFflj0v_CVrhTsXMUmapuTH-fRBlFYQH37ySwPlLn1ELN4Wg7UQT9wYTF3FOZ8o84OKhsW_TJwTqn2UKeg7rxDARb5sFFE%3D)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: | | | | | | Hi Friend, Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you. Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I just completed my SECOND debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! With my mandated FEC end-of-quarter deadline quickly approaching, I 'm hoping you'll consider pitching in a generous gift today! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. >> " ** | | | | | | | | | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, " I need your help â€“ starting right now. " Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. # Party of the Constitution
---
**Tickets will go on sale Monday** for the biggest Freedom Event of the Fall - Embrace the power of Medical Freedom! - a cause close to the heart of the Michigan Republican Party. Let's make our stand against aspiring tyrants Gov. Whitmer and President Biden resoundingly clear:**WE WILL NOT COMPLY!**
Let’s get ready to take action as we hear from US Senator Ron Johnson from Wisconsin to **FRISKE FARMS IN ELLSWORTH** on SATURDAY, OCT 21, 2023. Let's come together to send a strong message to any potential tyrant who wants to control our healthcare choices. Senator Johnson has consistently advocated for Medical Freedom and the right to choose. He has been a staunch opponent of vaccine mandates and supports the freedom to make our own decisions. This event promises to be unforgettable!
Please keep a close watch on your inbox for updates on ticket availability and VIP opportunities. These will be limited and in high demand. This is your chance to take a stand and declare your opposition to any vaccine mandates or lockdowns. Activists and liberty groups can participate in the event as sponsors, starting at $300. Chairwoman Kristina Karamo is committed to giving activists a prominent role and the ability to benefit from grassroots control of MIGOP.
**Save the date - October 21, 2023,** for a day of empowerment and unity at Friske Farms. Come with your loved ones and experience a welcoming atmosphere for kids and the amazing event. Let's come together and show our support for Medical Freedom and our God-given unalienable rights!

body:
Student loan payments are set to resume tomorrow, October 1st. Here's what you need to know. | | | Peter,
Last spring, after months of debt-ceiling negotiations with GOP House Speaker Kevin McCarthy, the Biden administration agreed to terminate the federal student loan payment pause — at a stroke, throwing 45 million people, a _generation_ of borrowers, into renewed economic insecurity. **Now, student loan payments are set to resume tomorrow, October 1st** —**** the _same day_ Republican extremists are set to force a government shutdown. Here’s what that means for you, and what you need to know before your official due date arrives:
* **If the government is closed down, payments for student loans will**** _still_****be due and interest will**** _still_****accrue.** You’ll begin, or continue, paying your loans through your student loan servicer’s website. Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

We can’t continue the piecemeal, inadequate status quo of government services. Our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Most families are living paycheck to paycheck.
But **the majority of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires**. They don’t understand what it feels like not being able to pay rent or make ends meet.
**I grew up in a working-class UAW household** , and my lived experience teaches me to lead with compassion. I understand how urgently we need bold federal action for economic justice.
I led the fight for the temporarily expanded Child Tax Credit, which lifted millions of children out of poverty in 2021 and cut child poverty in nearly half. But corporate Democrats and Republicans let it expire. So**I introduced legislation to cut childhood poverty by 70%** —by providing families with a universal benefit of nearly $400 per month per child.
I’m also fighting alongside restaurant workers to end the shameful federal tipped minimum wage of just $2.13 an hour—a starvation wage. I reintroduced the Restaurant Workers Bill of Rights to**ensure thriving wages, require paid leave and healthcare coverage, protect workers’ ability to unionize without fear of retaliation** , and more.
Last year, I led the fight in Congress to support rail workers preparing for a historic strike. And I ended up being one of the few Democrats who voted against forcing an unfair contract on them. Congress and the President squashed rail workers’ right to strike. We cannot undermine worker power again.
I’m calling on Democrats to truly be the party of the working class, and to **defend the right to strike—which is a powerful tool to fight corporate greed.**
**Our federal government is supposed to protect everyday people from corporate greed and exploitation. That’s the government I’m building, with your support.**

clean_body: Major victories in our movement to end poverty: | | | Friend, Earlier today I sent a message about ending poverty and fighting for workers’ rights—including protecting the right to strike, which is a powerful tool to fight corporate greed. Everyday people have been rising up , building powerful movements for social justice with popular support. This threatens right-wing leaders who maintain power by suppressing our voices. In backlash, they’reincreasing fascist repression against activists. Now, right-wing groups like ALEC are helping state and federal lawmakers try to take away a crucial tool in fights for freedom and equality: our right to boycott. This is an attack on our Constitution and our freedom of speech, one of the most critical rights that we have in our country. | While fascists ban books and censor conversations about race in schools, U.S. lawmakers and school administrators are also escalating attempts to criminalize and silence Americans who speak out against the Israeli government’s treatment of Palestinians. As the only Palestinian American in Congress, I continue to speak up for Palestinian rights and for Americans’ right to voice dissent and to criticize governments. I’m also one of the few national lawmakers speaking out in support of nonviolent Stop Cop City activists who are facing charges of domestic terrorism. Our rights are particularly precarious in this period of escalating oppression. But I’m not only defending our rights against unconstitutional attacks, I’m also pushing to expandour civil rights with policies like the Justice for All Act. Fascists and white supremacists try to distract us, burn us out, and take away our hope. But we must keep dreaming bigger. We cannot back down.We cannot cede ground. We’re so close to winning the transformative changes that our communities deserve. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | Thank you for fighting alongside me to protect and expand our fundamental rights. In solidarity, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Sat, Sep 30, 2023 Subject: Defending the right to strike, a powerful tool to fight corporate greed To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, You’re an essential part of our movement to end poverty, and we won major victories recently that wouldn’t be possible without you. We led the call in Congress to remove medical debt from credit reports when we introduced the** Restoring Unfairly Impaired Credit & Protecting Consumers Act. Now the Biden administration has announced executive action to do just that. This important step will belife-changing for millions of people whose credit scores impact access to housing and employment. I’m also honored to join striking UAW workers in my district who are making history fighting corporate greed. I’ve joined workers on the picket line and together we’ve sent hundreds of thousands of messages to the CEOs of the Big Three urging them to immediately meet workers’ demands. Now, this week, President Biden came to Michigan to join striking workers on the picket line—marking the first time a sitting president has done so. We’re leading the nation and building the power we need to enact sweeping, life-changing policies like universal paid sick leave and healthcare as a human right. None of this would be possible without your support. Today represents a critical fundraising deadline for our campaign and our movement for change. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | We can’t continue the piecemeal, inadequate status quo of government services. Our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. Most families are living paycheck to paycheck. But the majority of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires. They don’t understand what it feels like not being able to pay rent or make ends meet. I grew up in a working-class UAW household , and my lived experience teaches me to lead with compassion. I understand how urgently we need bold federal action for economic justice. I led the fight for the temporarily expanded Child Tax Credit, which lifted millions of children out of poverty in 2021 and cut child poverty in nearly half. But corporate Democrats and Republicans let it expire. SoI introduced legislation to cut childhood poverty by 70% —by providing families with a universal benefit of nearly $400 per month per child. I’m also fighting alongside restaurant workers to end the shameful federal tipped minimum wage of just $2.13 an hour—a starvation wage. I reintroduced the Restaurant Workers Bill of Rights toensure thriving wages, require paid leave and healthcare coverage, protect workers’ ability to unionize without fear of retaliation , and more. Last year, I led the fight in Congress to support rail workers preparing for a historic strike. And I ended up being one of the few Democrats who voted against forcing an unfair contract on them. Congress and the President squashed rail workers’ right to strike. We cannot undermine worker power again. I’m calling on Democrats to truly be the party of the working class, and to defend the right to strike—which is a powerful tool to fight corporate greed. Our federal government is supposed to protect everyday people from corporate greed and exploitation. That’s the government I’m building, with your support. Friend,
Grassroots supporters like you are the lifeblood of this campaign. Your input guides our strategy, your support builds our momentum, and your donations make everything that we do possible.
I’m proud to run a truly people-powered campaign. But that’s not the kind of campaign we’re up against.
I’m running against one of the richest Senators in Washington — a guy who spent $64 MILLION of his own fortune to buy this Senate seat last time around. That’s not even counting all the millions that he raised from far-right megadonors.
You shouldn’t be able to buy your way to Washington. But that’s exactly what Rick Scott did — and he’s trying to pull the same stunt in 2024 . Last year, he gave his campaign $4 MILLION to boost his end-of-quarter fundraising.
At the end of the day, this isn’t really about fundraising numbers or big checks. It’s about Rick Scott absolutely failing the Floridians he swore to protect: He wrote the plan to end Medicare and Social Security, pushed Trump’s election conspiracy theories, and advocated for a nationwide ban on abortions.
I’m running for Senate to give Floridians the leadership they deserve — and putting up big fundraising numbers is how we’re going to do it. That’s why I’ve set a big $350,000 end-of-quarter goal to make sure we have the resources we need to win this race. Please, will you split $20 between my campaign and Serve America to invest in this grassroots movement and flip Florida blue? I’m counting on your help to compete with Scott’s massive fortune. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Thank you so much,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

Peter,
Make no mistake: our opponent, Mitch McConnell, and national Republicans are going to pull out all the stops to flip PA.
Not only could this be my toughest re-election fight yet, our race could also be one of the most expensive in the country.
**[This moment matters. If you’re ready to help us hold this seat, chip in anything you can spare before our fundraising deadline at midnight.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230930-3?refcode=em20230930-3&refcode2=807_552475_vV01Re&akid=807%2E552475%2EvV01Re)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230930-3?refcode=em20230930-3&refcode2=807_552475_vV01Re&akid=807%2E552475%2EvV01Re)**
I know a thing or two about building a winning U.S. Senate campaign in Pennsylvania.
Still, it looks like this could be our toughest race yet.
We’re up against McConnell’s hand-picked candidate -- a mega-millionaire who could easily self-fund his campaign.
Plus, national Republicans are committed to doing in 2024 what they almost did here in 2022 and 2020 -- flip Pennsylvania red.
They didn’t win then, and Peter, they won’t win now. Not if we all come together ahead of this FEC deadline.
**[Please donate tonight if you can. Our deadline is just hours away.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230930-3?refcode=em20230930-3&refcode2=807_552475_vV01Re&akid=807%2E552475%2EvV01Re)**

Bob Casey

Last year, I lost this race by less than one percent because we were outspent 6 to 1 by Democrat Marie Perez. We cannot let that happen again - Marie is one of the most left-wing members of Congress.

Please make an emergency, last-minute contribution today to help me defeat her at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/fDTU2YuJ5q892z94KzbEubIg/YUy2Gnqup55MvDr29763U5IA).

Joe Kent

Our next major FEC deadline is at midnight TONIGHT. Here’s why your support *right now* is so critical:
#
Our next major FEC deadline is less than 12 hours away, Peter.
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[add a donation of any amount toward our goal of raising 35,000 individual donations before midnight.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37575?refcode=em20230930-3883&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3883%2E614464%2E7mB65h) But first, here are five reasons why your support right now is so critical:**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37575?refcode=em20230930-3883&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3883%2E614464%2E7mB65h)**
1. **Josh Hawley is vulnerable.** Hawley won his last race with only 51% of the vote. And now, a recent report from _Morning Consult_ shows that he’s the most unpopular GOP Senator up for re-election in 2024 — with an approval rating even lower than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida!
2. **National Republicans have made this race their top defensive target in 2024.** These insiders know that if they don’t step in to tear down Lucas and make Josh Hawley look strong, there’s a real chance they could lose this Senate seat. So from launching desperate attacks to a brand new GOP Super PAC, they’re already hard at work to keep this seat under their thumb.
3. **Missouri voters know how to take back their power at the ballot box.** In 2018, they rejected anti-union “Right-to-Work” and voted to raise the minimum wage well above the federal level. In 2020, they expanded Medicaid. And in 2022, they legalized weed. So in 2024, they’re ready to defeat Josh Hawley.
4. **Lucas Kunce has proved that he can harness that grassroots energy.** First, he outraised Hawley in the first six months of 2023. Then, he earned the support of the Missouri AFL-CIO, local and statewide leaders, major national organizations like League of Conservation Voters, and tens of thousands of everyday working people chipping in an average of $35.
5. **New polling shows Lucas in a statistical tie with Josh Hawley.** After nearly nine months of holding Hawley accountable to Missouri voters, Lucas has put this race in a dead heat — more than a year out from Election Day, with 12% of voters still undecided. This is the clearest sign yet that we really can flip this seat.

**But now, we’ve got to keep this momentum going.** Tonight’s deadline is the next real chance pundits, insiders, and voters will have to assess the strength of our campaign — and we need to continue proving that we’re building the movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and take back power for everyday people. So we have to ask:

| Good afternoon, friend.

We're writing today to ask if you can make a $10 contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate before our FEC fundraising deadline comes to a close tonight.

Why $10 specifically?

$10 because Michigan is going to be one of the most expensive and competitive Senate races of the cycle.

$10 because, as of this month, we’re likely to face a tough Republican opponent.

$10 because when this FEC fundraising deadline ends, we're legally required to report exactly how much money we've raised. So both friends and competitors will be watching what we report – and since this is our first report since our Republican opponent got in the race, everyone will be looking to see how we stack up.

$10 because Elissa doesn’t take corporate PAC money and is relying on individuals like you to chip in a few bucks at a time.

It may not seem like $10 can make a huge difference in one of the most competitive and expensive Senate races in the country, but by the time you get to this point in the email, a few folks have already made their donation.

Now, we're asking you to do the same before our deadline ends.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: difficult decisions.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I had to make a pretty difficult decision yesterday, and I thought you should know about it.
#

Hey there, Peter, it's Ruben again.
I had to make a pretty difficult decision earlier yesterday, and I thought you should know about it.
First, we’ve got our FEC deadline today. A big day for any campaign. But we’ve also got the looming prospect of Kari Lake and her campaign announcement — reported to come next month, right after this critical deadline. And Kyrsten Sinema threw a big high dollar fundraiser yesterday, where she probably pulled in a few hundred thousand dollars from her billionaire pals. She’s getting ready.
We can’t get ambushed here. Anything can happen right now.
Without saying too much, there are a number of investments we have to make in order to be prepared. Because if our opponents get the jump on us, we’re cooked. Game over.
The money wasn't in the budget to make those investments, but I gave the green light, even though we are short of our FEC deadline goals. A deadline that ends tomorrow.
I’m banking on the fact that telling you this will convince you to help us fill the gap.
Now... what that really means is... I need your help. Really. So please:
[**Can you make a$3 contribution to my campaign for Senate today? Every donation will help fill the gaping hole in our budget ahead of tonight’s critical FEC fundraising deadline.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept23.a-3sdr&refcode=em230930-3-t1&t=1&akid=1298%2E734936%2Eh5Gmu9)
This was a difficult decision. But if there’s one thing that sets our campaign apart from all the others in this race, it’s you. You are keeping us in this fight.
Thanks for chipping in today if you can afford it.
And thanks for being in this fight,
Ruben

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: It was a good summer ☀️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
And we made it happen together.
#
To our supporters and friends,
This past weekend marked the official end of summer, and I wanted to take a moment to recognize all we accomplished together over the last 3 months.
My team organized a massive back-to-school push to help our NY-14 students return to school with their heads held high. Thanks to your support, we gave out **1,150 backpacks filled with school supplies**. And with the help of over **100 volunteers** , we distributed these backpacks and another 155 hygiene kits at **26 family events** in our district, where we enrolled **200 new students** in our free, virtual tutoring program for underserved families, in partnership with Learn to Be.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230930-am.kMq8iA&refcode=em20230930-5076-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5076%2E2526796%2EUexsbr)
[I’m so proud of what we’ve been able to do for our community. If you can, could you help us fuel future community events with a contribution?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230930-am.kMq8iA&refcode=em20230930-5076-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5076%2E2526796%2EUexsbr)
Together, we also made this a Hot Labor Summer for the history books. I walked the practice picket line in solidarity with the **Teamsters** in demand of a fair UPS contract, and they won big — securing **historic wage increases, eliminating unfair wage tiers, no mandatory overtime, A/C in trucks, and much more.**
We marched with SAG-AFTRA and WGA, the latter of which reached a tentative deal — which includes **success-based residuals, strong limitations on AI, guaranteed employment length** , to name a few — just this week.
On Twitch, I also raised $10,000 for DSA’s Emergency Workplace Organizing Committee, who help workers organize their workplaces.
And just last week, Rep. Cori Bush and I traveled to Wentzville, Missouri to rally with **UAW Local 2250** , days before President Biden’s visit to the UAW picket line — the first president to do so in American history, compelled by the power of labor.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230930-am.kMq8iA&refcode=em20230930-5076-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5076%2E2526796%2EUexsbr)
And finally, I led the **first all Spanish-speaking delegation from the U.S.** — which included Representatives Nydia Velázquez, Greg Casar, Maxwell Frost, and Joaquin Castro — on a tour of Brazil, Chile, and Colombia. Our hope was that this visit could help chart a new course for the relationship between the United States and Latin America.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230930-am.kMq8iA&refcode=em20230930-5076-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5076%2E2526796%2EUexsbr)
**Our work is far from over.** With your faith in our mass movement, it’s possible to win against corporate greed, it’s possible to secure a healthy planet for future generations, and it’s possible to win a democracy that serves and is served by working people.
On behalf of our team, our community, and our movement: **thank you!**
Yours in community,
Alexandria
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230930-am.kMq8iA&refcode=em20230930-5076-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=5076%2E2526796%2EUexsbr)**

body:
| | Hi Peter — I don’t think we’ve met yet. I’m Kathianne Williams, Brian’s wife.

Brian and I have been married for 18 years, together for 22 years, and are opposites in a lot of ways. Brian is the oldest of 2 children, and I’m the youngest of 6 children. Brian grew up in a military family that moved a lot, and I lived in the same house until I left for college. I’m an open book, and Brian is very private.

Before the shooting on July 7, 2016, Brian was not on social media at all, he turned down any media interviews, and he didn’t even want me to post his picture on my social media accounts. But something changed in him the night of the press conference.

Brian’s life has been about answering the call to serve: from the call to serve in the Air Force, to the call to become a surgeon, to now answering the call to run for Congress.

# Last Chance: Will You Stand with America First?
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Fellow Patriots, **_Our third quarter deadline is tonight, and right now, we’re $21,000 short of our goal._** [That’s why I’m asking you: what can you give **TODAY** to propel our campaign forward? Any amount, no matter the size, sends a strong message to the political insiders in Washington that We the People won’t be silenced or ignored.](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=5abb413d37&e=0be619cbaa) As you know, the Republican Establishment is doing everything they can to try to keep our grassroots campaign from succeeding. To fight back and win, we need the financial support of voters like you who understand just how important it is for America First policies to be championed in this race. This past week made one thing clear: the GOP presidential primary is still **WIDE OPEN**. The experts and the public both agree that there wasn’t a single candidate on that debate stage who moved the needle. That’s because none of them were willing to put America First. I will always put America First. While the GOP Establishment kept us out of the last two debates, we have taken our message directly to the people, and across the country, our rallies have been packed with patriotic Americans who are sick of the status quo. [Your donation, whether it’s $50, $25, or simply $10 dollars, helps us bypass the establishment gatekeepers and continue to grow our movement. With your support, we can stand against the Radical Left and defeat their efforts to tear our great country apart. ](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=ad13604081&e=0be619cbaa) Thanks,

My fellow House Democrats and I are committed to passing policies that benefit families, not radical special interests. Chip in to our 2024 Victory Fund today and help us break the Republican supermajority. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tnhousedems2023]
