Peter, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and I supported striking UAW Local 2250 workers last weekend in Missouri. We’re joining workers in saying: **Record corporate profits should mean record contracts for workers!** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953y_3_6q7pxG0RDApdDqptJRT1FvVwVt4r0_1m5FKi5JCB0mOr783-D7DImgMl-vUInpDPZnAiKU_xWhmO7axV0uddUnV_BU7GwAMl6sMFY5P6iFzCQ-dy784f22ia8kX8q4rWgkCo-FqqsaoyymF3WQ2T63Nom9PqWMi8NYgfeLfK-0whqJRLua5RLIu2TjhocFv7VlA6gz01w0qH7b7fDeFJ6aAVObtHVLME8YX00TWOoKuqv73XV_EVzjauACaNoZjwRVcL8sYIdHyQyl_W1RDlqLZdHQt05Jq9Lv7LHScdTA_5cE01ggtcIAHmpEw86Zed0CYwVssKnKJpQetdRRA47tcoVYIpqY8VwRQ24xlw/401/VMEMBZKiSiGLZ_rvz5BXqg/h0/dHoDsKnDhJEstFzPgQaxGB0P5ZhR4RAzPua9gn312G8) When executives can afford yachts and multiple vacation homes, yet their workers struggle to afford to pay for housing, that’s a red flag, it’s time for a change. **I’ve been a low-wage worker, and so has AOC. We understand the urgency of everyday people’s struggles to pay the bills. clean_body: We’re powerful when we join together in solidarity. | | Peter, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and I supported striking UAW Local 2250 workers last weekend in Missouri. We’re joining workers in saying: Record corporate profits should mean record contracts for workers! When executives can afford yachts and multiple vacation homes, yet their workers struggle to afford to pay for housing, that’s a red flag, it’s time for a change. I’ve been a low-wage worker, and so has AOC. We understand the urgency of everyday people’s struggles to pay the bills. That’s why we’re pushing in Congress for the bold changes our communities deserve. For example, AOC and I have pushed for a Green New Deal and a Civilian Climate Corps, and our movement for good green jobs just won an important victory when the Biden administration launched the American Climate Corps last week. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Thank you. In solidarity and with love, Cori Peter, I just joined Cori Bush in Wentzville, Missouri to support and talk with striking workers from UAW Local 2250. When workers demand better, they’re speaking up on behalf of workers everywhere. And thanks to the resurgence of worker organizing, this week President Biden joined UAW strikers in solidarity -- becoming the first President in modern American history to join a union picket line. We also won a victory in the movement for high-quality, good-paying green jobs last week, as the Biden administration launched the American Climate Corps. The program will create clean energy and climate resilience jobs for more than 20,000 young people in its first year. This is an important moment in the movement for economic justice, climate justice, and worker power. Cori Bush and I have been low-wage workers, and our experiences fuel us to push for bold federal action. We’re leading policy solutions that are big enough to match the crises that everyday people are facing. ** In a pattern that’s playing out across industries, the “Big Three” auto companies have jacked up CEO pay to ludicrous levels and wasted hundreds of millions of dollars on stock buybacks to manipulate prices -- all while starving the workers who actually make their products. We must have workers’ backs, especially in this time of rising inequality and corporate influence in politics. I’m proud to join Cori in supporting all workers in demanding better pay and better working conditions. And thanks to the recent launch of the American Climate Corps, we’re now closer to a Green New Deal that would create millions of high-wage union jobs. We are so much more powerful when we join together in solidarity. And there’s so much more work to do to ensure economic justice for all. body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2024647?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT BEAR PETITION: Trophy hunters are KILLING innocent grizzlies for sport. We need better protection for these iconic creatures before it’s too late![Act Now>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2024648?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** As BIG as grizzlies are, it only takes **ONE** bullet to **_KILL_** them Friend. Unfortunately, bloody carcasses of these large mammals have been discovered with _**more than 20 gunshot wounds!**_ The brutal massacre of grizzly bears and cubs is a VICIOUS game to cruel trophy hunters. They’re using more than just bullets. Weapons range from **leg snares, sharp bear traps, and even _DYNAMITE._** This is not a defense tactic— trophy hunters are **_PURPOSEFULLY_** killing innocent bears and cubs for souvenirs. States just outside Yellowstone National Park are a _deadly_ zone for roaming grizzlies. With no understanding of _invisible_ state lines, wandering a few miles outside of Yellowstone could cost a vulnerable mama grizzly and her cubs their lives. Without expanded protection from the Endangered Species Act, the population of our nation’s most iconic mammal will continue to decline. There are now fewer than **2,000 grizzlies remaining in the lower 48 states.** With only a few months remaining until hibernation, bear cubs could not withstand losing their mother. No one to help defend them from predators, provide food for nourishment, and provide shelter for their protection and growth. They would be left to die from **HYPOTHERMIA** or **STARVATION**. [_**Please, Friend, we could risk losing more of our beloved grizzlies if we do not demand stronger ESA protections. Sign the petition by 11:59pm TONIGHT to speak up and SAVE grizzly bears and cubs >>** _](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2024649?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2024650?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

In our fight to protect grizzly bears, many far-right lawmakers have been pushing an **anti-bear** agenda that could **roll-back Endangered Species Act protections even __FURTHER__****.** Big Polluters and trophy hunting lobbyists are all working hand in hand to aggressively advance dangerous laws that could push grizzlies closer to _**EXTINCTION**_. Friend,
---
My family’s story is living proof of the American Dream. My grandfather was born in Mexico. He had next to nothing, but he shared in America’s values of service, duty, and freedom. That’s why he earned his American citizenship by fighting Nazis during World War II and received two Purple Hearts for his service. Growing up, my grandparents always instilled that same spirit of service in me. **I wanted to protect the freedoms for which my grandfather fought, so I joined the U.S. Army as a Black Hawk pilot fighting in some of the world’s most dangerous skies. ** It was hard work, but I knew it was worth it because I was preserving the American Dream for so many families like my own.
---
[**PROTECT THE AMERICAN DREAM**](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=ff3c0964a7f94324b78003d63776a6de&_e=fwNI1OLDDgVOP9ZVijNGWDrOWYF4ZaG_lPGraa5lEm08DbFu8FWu4mkndfH8zwGu_vRXc17DAmAfD2zt9ugWKZBy2ABKLUoYJB8-PDd0fgyFAFHxXriH1g3kgA0xF9547cCZE9kOPlp-7D7kkygOtl86-ySmLHsojnSAOB6nwx8dOQm9u4prFXWxKk77WsacJ7s84mhzw7RPXEDgSlAK3Xt31b7UuL3_GeJgcLGUtxDBPMRI833WsN032gBJyvL1TSRh3PnlbYD9aJnoz7n-wCZ2XUbB9dOO9jqZmDvTI1XFllCLP72MH3OESBB-Fx8FBYVIyNJEdMxPda1ZgoefuT6mnD_DOUTNtOetooT7VLY231ACFU0czsINKLdFXKj1rwBZwh7asA1vim0fZm-yxQSfiNLVDCN8uWJW9fmGb9VlR8X9XCt_Td64dQYEqL7VA67_LV1w61_FeMZ4wj-R3ccGKSZjiVYkamQRY7scRf0%3D)

_But when my military career was over, my work wasn’t done. _ I knew that America’s enemies weren’t just abroad; they were roaming our streets as violent criminals. I went on to serve as a police officer, keeping my community safe. That’s why I will ALWAYS back the blue. **I’m proud of both my service and my family’s heritage. But the truth is, money matters. It's how we pay our team, run ads, and buy clipboards for volunteers knocking on doors. And it matters a lot when you're up against Mike Lawler, who will have millions of dollars from Kevin McCarthy, Elise Stefanik, and his corporate PAC allies. Winning or losing this thing may come down to how much we can raise.

**So, I need to ask: Will you step up and contribute $5 or whatever you can before our first end-of-quarter deadline to power this grassroots campaign? Here's a personal link for you:** **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mj-q3-email&refcode2=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70687573/430126400/13284604?refcode=em23_230930_EOM7_fndd_gq_act___MJ_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_230930_EOM7_fndd_gq_act___MJ_ettx&utm_medium=email&utm_source=mondaire-jones&refcode2=b1500151-d45f-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTUwMDE1MS1kNDVmLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cC4ySh-qb6F6DDWdmnI_boUM-mtzegWSZ7WexyHWeOM=)**

I am in this to make life better for lower Hudson Valley residents and the community that raised me.

For the parents who wonder every month if they'll be able to pay their bills or put food on the table.

For all the seniors who go into debt because they can't afford the outrageous cost of their prescription drugs.

I'm running for the single parents, for the teachers, for the veterans, and for everyday people—young and old—who have the most at stake.

**I'm running to get greed out of politics. That's why I refuse to take a penny of corporate PAC money.**

Look—my first FEC end-of-quarter deadline is at midnight tonight. Soon, our fundraising numbers will be made public for everyone to see. I’m counting on your support before midnight to help us reach our $100,000 goal so we can show Mike Lawler and his far-right allies just how strong our grassroots movement is.

subject: I will get right to the point.

body:
I know there are a number of organizations and campaigns in your inbox asking you for your support.
#
Derek, this is Paul Eaton.
I know you appreciate it when we get to the point.
And I know there are several organizations and campaigns in your inbox asking you for your support.
So, I am asking you to consider VoteVets. If you’re ready to make a contribution, you can use my link:
**[https://act.votevets.org/go/Eaton-EOQ](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sept23.AXrwBB&refcode=em230930-2-15&t=1&akid=17389%2E3013755%2EjVirr5)**
As a retired General who was confirmed by the Senate, Tommy Tuberville’s hold on promotions for our most senior officers is something that strikes very close to home for me.
The reason the American warrior does the amazing things he or she does is trust. Trust in the chain of command and trust in America and her government. This Tuberville stunt is doing irreparable harm to that essential trust between our civilian and Military leaders.
That is why I am so proud of the work we have done to move these promotions forward. It is critical to our National Security, yes. But it is also critical to the fabric of our country and our Democracy.
We will not stop until we finish the fight. But to do that, we will need your help.
Support from people like you is critical. We haven’t convinced you to donate yet, but we’re hoping that today is the day you make your first donation. Do it ahead of our critical end-of-quarter FEC deadline.
**[$5 is the amount we need. But the truth is, the amount is less important than the donation itself. So if you are with us, please commit to making that contribution.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sept23.AXrwBB&refcode=em230930-2-15&t=2&akid=17389%2E3013755%2EjVirr5)**

****
Thank you.
Your support does not go unnoticed.
Maj. Gen. Paul Eaton, US Army, Retired

I am going to level with you: This quarter has proven to be incredibly challenging for political fundraising.
I have been spending a lot of my time on the House floor, negotiating with Republicans, holding lawmakers accountable in hearings, and writing up bills that will benefit Americans. To sum it all up, I have been working hard to fight for the people that elected me.
But that also means I can’t spend as much time focusing on my reelection campaign and fundraising.
This campaign was built from the ground up by grassroots supporters, like you, chipping in a few bucks at a time when they can. And that still stands true today. So the success of this campaign quite literally depends on your support.
But the reality is, political fundraising has slowed for us like never before, and if we don’t catch up by our FEC deadline at midnight and report a strong number, MAGA extremists could come after me and this seat.
I have no doubt in my mind that they want me gone. I call them out for their lies, deceit, fraud, and disrespect. And they know as long as I am in Congress, I won’t be afraid to confront and expose them.
So if I show even an ounce of weakness after this FEC deadline, they are going to send in their candidate to take me down. And we cannot risk having another extremist in Congress.
**But tonight we have an opportunity to show them just how strong we are and the depth of grassroots support for my campaign.**
**[So please, if you can today, contribute $3 or anything you can afford to my reelection campaign to keep me in Congress fighting for accountability and the American people. I would not ask if it weren't important.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70689103/430130136/-1110456150?refcode2=23bfd37f-d85f-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&refcode=em230930-1-t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2JmZDM3Zi1kODVmLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EyQkgAFbZdh11Tn9st8JHGcNllppwQF8-marSbQNAc8=)**
I am grateful for the support this team has given me so far and I will continue to fight for Americans, our democracy, and the accountability of lawmakers as long as I serve in Congress.
Thank you,
Robert Garcia

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ZAK FOR CONGRESS
body:
#
Hey There – I know you are getting bombarded with emails about “urgent deadlines” and I assure you this is not one of those.
Politics moves extremely fast, and most of us just have time for the headlines.
Recently, the headlines in NY-03 have been about George Santos, his 13 felony charges, and more endless drama and finger-pointing.
At the heart of this campaign is the core belief that New Yorkers deserve a better brand of politics: one where leaders put their constituents first and where dignity and respect are guiding principles.
New Yorkers deserve headlines about how we are raising the minimum wage, lowering prescription drug prices, funding early education, and investing in emerging industries.
Our campaign is not about hitting a goal or settling a score with a political rival. It is really about tapping into our potential and refocusing on what actually matters.
Yes, there is an FEC deadline at midnight and, yes, my finance team is working overtime to keep us competitive. This race is going to be expensive and close, so we could really use your support.
With a $10 donation we can get back to campaigning, spreading our message, and building the grassroots team to unseat Santos and flip this district blue. **Here’s the link to give:** [**secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq?amount=10?amount=10&refcode=em230930-90do)
I cannot thank you enough for being a part of our team.
With gratitude,
Zak

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Roger serves on the Board of Trustees for the Bush School of Government and Public Service at Texas A&M University, the Texas Christian University Board of Trustees, and the National Football Foundation and College Football Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

Folks,

Last year, our team stood tall and helped elect Nikki to Congress. We overcame her opponent’s extremism by ensuring folks knew Nikki’s biggest priority in Washington would be to to pass bipartisan, commonsense legislation.

And since coming to Congress, she’s proved that it wasn’t just a talking point. She’s continued to advocate for the needs of farmers, veterans, and workers in Central and Southern Illinois by working across the aisle to introduce legislation supporting veterans mental health and standing on the picket lines with UAW workers, among so many other critical fights.

But this didn’t happen overnight, folks. Months’ worth of support from folks like you went into her win and all the progress we’ve accomplished so far.

It’s because we started investing early that we were able to overcome every obstacle and help Nikki win her first race, and we know this grassroots team is capable of helping her win again.

# [#]
Peter, I know what your inbox looks like right now. Lots of exclamation points & highlights. Urgent, desperate, match!!! Campaign finance in this country is ridiculous, broken and wasteful. But if we want the opportunity to change it, we need to raise the money.

As someone who opened a retail store in my town, it feels very odd to ask people for money and not give them something in return. One thing you learn running your own small business is that every penny matters, good employees who are treated with dignity and respect are invaluable (some of my former employees are working with us on the campaign!) and there’s a difference between an investment and an expense.

Right now, I am asking you to invest in my campaign to take back NY17. I think we need sane, reasonable people in our government more interested in solving problems than becoming political influencers on social media

If you would like to support that, here’s a link to use: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwg-fr-2309?amount= [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwg-fr-2309?amount=]

And because the retailer in me wants to give you a little something too, below is my favorite terrible joke.

What did the snail say when it was riding on the turtle’s back?

WHEEEEEEEEEE!!!!

Thank you for your support! The good news is that September only has 30 days, so come Sunday, you will get a break from all the fundraising for a bit.

:)
Liz

body:
We may have avoided a shutdown, saving millions of families
Today, House Democrats overwhelmingly voted for a bipartisan agreement to keep the government from shutting down, despite 91 Republican votes in favor of a shutdown.

# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4188%2E5257348%2Ej4axqB)

Hi Derek — it’s Eve Schiff.
I already know what you’re about to say. Yes, Adam and Eve. We’ve heard all the jokes!
But I’m reaching out today with an important ask: Adam is facing his end-of-quarter FEC deadline (that’s the Federal Election Commission) in just a few hours. He needs our support right now.
**You can donate here:[secure.actblue.com/donate/sep2023_abs_em](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2023_abs_em.H56YJI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC30_20230930_PM3_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=5&akid=4188%2E5257348%2Ej4axqB)**
For the last few years, Adam has been at the forefront of some of our nation’s most important fights.
He investigated Donald Trump. He led the first impeachment trial. His work has helped hold people accountable for January 6th.
But as you and I have seen, these fights have also made Adam one of the GOP’s top targets.
By _Fox News._
By the likes of Kevin McCarthy and Matt Gaetz in Congress.
By Trump himself — including just yesterday at the California GOP convention in Anaheim.
Adam is tough and has weathered the attacks well — but I will admit, the viciousness of the attacks concerns me. It wasn’t easy watching him get censured in the House of Representatives, but I was so proud of Adam and how he fought back.
The attacks have only gotten worse since launching his Senate campaign.
**That’s why Adam’s deadline with the FEC tonight is so important.**
It’s clear these bullies have no intention of stopping their attacks against Adam. Trump will continue attacking him. His far-right accomplices in Congress will keep attacking him. Their online MAGA supporters will keep attacking him.
Adam has never been afraid to stand up to bullies. But with the attacks escalating by the day, he’ll need our help to cut through the noise (_there’s a lot of it_) and power his work through Election Day.
**As Adam faces this critical deadline, I hope you will show support today to help reach his goal. It would mean the world to me.**
**Here’s that link one more time:[secure.actblue.com/donate/sep2023_abs_em](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2023_abs_em.H56YJI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC30_20230930_PM3_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=6&akid=4188%2E5257348%2Ej4axqB)**
California’s next Senator needs to be ready to defend our democracy and its institutions.
Somebody who’s fought the tough battles before — and won.
Somebody who knows that right and truth and decency matter.
Somebody who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and deliver for Californians.
That person is Adam.
Thank you for always standing alongside Adam. I know there’s nothing we can’t accomplish with you on our team.
— Eve

| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/70693496/430142324/1714615580?sourceid=1052059&refcode=20230930_ERMEOQ_v1s1&refcode2=WTEFE955&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDIxMDkxYi1lNTVmLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8ZNQoEUKxRmVK8rYoZEfxRHF3r-l3u6_Pc2k1rMk4hk=) Peter,

As this quarter comes to a close, we approach the year-out mark from the second major election since the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_.

The political landscape today looks drastically different than it did last November. Republican politicians, hellbent on rolling back _decades_ of progress, have passed dangerous and draconian abortion bans. Now, they’re hoping to gain control of Congress so they can pass a **national abortion ban.**

I’m blown away by how folks have stepped up to show support for my campaign. This week, you’ve heard why this race and tonight’s deadline are so important from US Senator Chris Murphy, Fred Guttenberg, and the most important person in my life, my wife.

These people know me well, and while running for office was never part of my plan, I’m honored and humbled to have their support. I’ll be honest though, at times I'm a bit uncomfortable putting myself out there. **But as an Air Force veteran, I can tell you from experience that answering the call during times of crisis is not about comfort – it’s about service before self.**

With the many intersecting crises occurring in our country, I’m answering the call to serve. I will take my frontline experience to Congress and work to end needless suffering and violence harming our communities, and to uplift all seeking a better life.
